articles.title: Perioperative durvalumab plus fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin, and docetaxel for resectable gastric and gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (MATTERHORN): final results of overall survival and event-free survival by pathological response in a global, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicentre, phase 3 trial
articles.authors: Janjigian YY, Al-Batran SE, Wainberg ZA, Muro K, Molena D, Van Cutsem E, Hyung WJ, Wyrwicz L, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Durvalumab plus perioperative fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin, and docetaxel (FLOT) previously improved event-free survival and pathological complete response in resectable gastric and gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. We aimed to examine its effect on overall survival.
abstract.textZh: Durvalumab加上圍手術期氟尿嘧啶、亞葉酸、奧沙利鉑和多西紫杉醇（ FLOT ）先前改善了可切除胃癌和胃食管交界處腺癌的無事件生存期和病理完全緩解。我們的目標是檢查它對整體存活率的影響。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: MATTERHORN is a global, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicentre, phase 3 trial that took place in 147 medical centres in 20 countries (representing Asia, Europe, North America, and South America). Adults with histologically documented resectable gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma (eligible for radical surgery; stage II-IVa) not previously treated with anticancer therapy were eligible. Participants were randomly assigned (1:1) to perioperative durvalumab plus FLOT or placebo plus FLOT. Blocked randomisation (unique randomisation number via an interactive response technology system and randomisation and trial supply management system) was stratified by geographical region, clinical lymph node status, and PD-L1 expression. Participants were centrally assigned using the interactive response technology system and randomisation and trial supply management system. Participants received durvalumab 1500 mg or placebo intravenously every 4 weeks on day 1 of each cycle plus FLOT intravenously every 2 weeks on days 1 and 15 of each cycle for four cycles (two neoadjuvant and two adjuvant), followed by durvalumab 1500 mg or placebo intravenously every 4 weeks on day 1 of each cycle for ten additional cycles. Participants, investigators, and those assessing outcomes were masked. The previously reported primary outcome was event-free survival; overall survival in the intention-to-treat population was a key secondary endpoint and is the main endpoint reported here. Safety data were collected throughout treatment and the follow-up period (up to and including 90 days after the last dose of the trial drug) and were analysed in participants who received at least one dose of trial treatment; these data were reported previously and are summarised here. MATTERHORN is closed to recruitment but is ongoing and registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT04592913).
abstract.textZh: MATTERHORN是一項全球性、隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照、多中心、3期試驗，在20個國家（代表亞洲、歐洲、北美和南美）的147個醫療中心進行。 有組織學記錄的可切除胃癌或胃食管交界處腺癌（符合根治性手術資格； II-IVa期）且先前未接受過抗癌治療的成人符合資格。 參與者被隨機分配(1: 1)到圍手術期durvalumab加上FLOT或安慰劑加上FLOT。 依地理區域、臨牀淋巴結狀態和PD-L1表現分層阻斷隨機分組（透過互動反應技術系統和隨機分組和試驗供應管理系統的獨特隨機分組編號）。 使用互動反應技術系統以及隨機分配和試驗供應管理系統集中分配參與者。 參與者在每個週期的第1天每4週靜脈注射durvalumab 1500 mg或安慰劑，在每個週期的第1天和第15天每2週靜脈注射FLOT ，共4個週期（兩個新輔助劑和兩個輔助劑） ，然後在每個週期的第1天每4週靜脈注射durvalumab 1500 mg或安慰劑，共10個額外週期。 參與者、調查人員和評估結果的人被遮蔽。 先前報告的主要結果是無事件生存期；意向治療族羣中的總生存期是關鍵次要終點，也是主要終點

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: From Nov 17, 2020, to Sept 2, 2022, 1258 participants were enrolled and 948 were randomly assigned; 474 were randomly assigned to durvalumab and 474 to placebo. In a total of 948 participants, the median age was 62 years (IQR 54-68), 682 (72%) were male, and 266 (28%) were female. Overall survival significantly improved in the durvalumab versus placebo group (hazard ratio 0·78, 95% CI 0·63-0·96; p=0·021; significance threshold p<0·0499). Adverse events with the outcome of death possibly related to any trial treatment occurred in 6 (1%) of 475 participants in the durvalumab group and 2 (<1%) of 469 participants in the placebo group.
abstract.textZh: 從2020年11月17日至2022年9月2日， 1258名參與者被招募， 948人被隨機分配； 474人被隨機分配到durvalumab ， 474人被隨機分配到安慰劑。在總共948名參與者中，中位年齡為62歲（ IQR 54-68 ） ， 682名（ 72 ％ ）為男性， 266名（ 28 ％ ）為女性。與安慰劑組相比， durvalumab組的整體存活期顯著改善（風險比0 · 78 ， 95% CI 0 · 63-0 · 96 ； p = 0 · 021 ；顯著閾值p < 0 · 0499 ）。durvalumab組的475名參與者中有6名（ 1% ）和安慰劑組的469名參與者中有2名（ < 1% ）發生了可能與任何試驗治療相關的死亡結局的不良事件。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Perioperative durvalumab plus FLOT improved overall survival versus placebo plus FLOT and is a new standard treatment option for patients with resectable gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.

articles.title: Wildfire smoke and health: current evidence, mechanisms, and future challenges
articles.authors: Chen G, Xu R, Yu P, Liu Y, Henderson SB, Johnston FH, Yue X, Bell ML, et al.

abstract.text: In the era of climate change, numerous regions worldwide are facing a surge in both the frequency and unprecedented scale of wildfires. Exposure to wildfire smoke poses substantial risks to health, especially for vulnerable populations. Although previous studies have shed light on health effects of wildfire smoke, crucial research gaps persist, including long-term health effects, interactions with pre-existing health conditions, and health disparities. Closing these gaps is vital to enhancing the ability to safeguard public health during wildfire events and to formulate effective strategies for prevention, mitigation, and response. This Review synthesises global evidence on the trends, health effects, and physical and chemical characteristics of wildfire smoke, exploring potential biological mechanisms and challenges in health risk assessment. Acknowledging the global impact of wildfires and their health effects is essential for mitigating environmental, social, and economic challenges. Safeguarding public health requires an interdisciplinary approach to comprehensively address the public health burden from wildfires. This integrated strategy is essential to systematically assess and mitigate the substantial public health burden posed by wildfires, as well as promoting resilience and sustainable solutions for affected communities.
abstract.textZh: 在氣候變遷的時代，全球許多地區正面臨野火頻繁和前所未有的規模。 接觸野火煙霧對健康構成重大風險，特別是對弱勢人羣。 儘管先前的研究已經揭示了野火煙霧對健康的影響，但關鍵的研究差距仍然存在，包括長期健康影響、與先前存在的健康狀況的相互作用以及健康差距。 縮小這些差距對於提高在野火事件期間保護公共健康的能力以及制定有效的預防、緩解和應對策略至關重要。 本綜述綜合了有關野火煙霧的趨勢、健康影響以及物理和化學特性的全球證據，探索了健康風險評估中的潛在生物機制和挑戰。 承認野火的全球影響及其對健康的影響，對於減輕環境、社會和經濟挑戰至關重要。 維護公共衛生需要跨學科的方法來全面解決野火造成的公共衛生負擔。 這項綜合策略對於系統地評估和減輕野火造成的重大公共衛生負擔，以及促進受影響社區的復原力和可持續解決方案至關重要。

articles.title: Use of the bacterial lysate OM-85 for the primary prevention of wheezing lower respiratory illness in preschool children: a randomised, placebo-controlled trial
articles.authors: Morgan WJ, Mauger DT, Bacharier LB, Bauer CS, Davis SD, Fitzpatrick AM, Guilbert TW, Jackson DJ, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Wheezing lower respiratory tract illnesses are a major health concern in preschool children. We report the results of the ORBEX trial which evaluated the safety and efficacy of the bacterial lysate, OM-85, in the primary prevention of wheezing lower respiratory tract illness.
abstract.textZh: 喘息的下呼吸道疾病是學齡前兒童的主要健康問題。我們報告了ORBEX試驗的結果，該試驗評估了細菌裂解物OM-85在預防喘息下呼吸道疾病方面的安全性和有效性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: ORBEX is a parallel-arm, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial for the primary prevention of wheezing lower respiratory tract illness in young children at increased risk for asthma due to atopic dermatitis, parental asthma, or asthma in a blood sibling aged 4 years or older. Children aged 6-18 months were centrally randomly assigned (1:1) at 11 academic clinical sites with experience in recruiting young children in the USA to receive OM-85 3·5 mg or placebo orally for 10 days each month for 24 months and then followed for an additional 36 months to evaluate outcomes while they were off the study drug. Identical openable capsules were used for active drug and placebo, and staff, investigators, and participants were masked to treatment assignment. Participants received usual treatment for wheezing illness as per US guidelines. Randomisation was stratified by sex, age group, family history of asthma, and clinical site. The primary outcome was the time to first wheezing lower respiratory tract illness during the 36-month observation period off the study drug analysed in the intention-to-treat population, which included all randomly assigned participants. The trial is registered with clinicaltrials.gov, NCT02148796, and is completed.
abstract.textZh: ORBEX是一項平行組、雙盲、安慰劑對照試驗，用於預防4歲或以上血液兄弟姐妹中因特應性皮炎、父母哮喘或哮喘而增加哮喘風險的幼兒下呼吸道疾病。 將6-18個月大的兒童集中隨機分配(1: 1)到11個具有招募美國年幼兒童的經驗的學術臨牀中心，每月接受OM-85 3.5毫克或安慰劑口服10天，持續24個月，然後再追蹤36個月，以評估他們離開研究藥物的結果。 活性藥物和安慰劑使用相同的可開啟膠囊，工作人員、研究者和參與者被遮蓋在治療指派上。 參與者根據美國指南接受了喘息疾病的常規治療。 隨機分組按性別、年齡組、哮喘家族史和臨牀部位分層。 主要結果是在意向治療族羣中分析的研究藥物在36個月觀察期間首次喘息下呼吸道疾病的時間，其中包括所有隨機分配的參與者。 試驗已在clinicaltrials.gov ， NCT02148796註冊，並已完成。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Jan 3, 2017, and Nov 30, 2020, 984 children were screened for eligibility, 162 were excluded, and 822 were randomly assigned (411 to the OM-85 intervention group and 411 to the placebo group). 492 participants were male (59·9%) and 330 (40·1%) were female and the mean age of participants was 11·8 months (SD 3·8). 681 children completed the 24-month treatment period, and 596 children completed the 36-month observation period. 132 children experienced at least one wheezing lower respiratory tract illness during the observation period; 71 (21%) of 342 in the OM-85 group and 61 (18%) of 339 in the placebo group. There was no significant difference between OM-85 and placebo with respect to the time to first wheezing lower respiratory tract illness (log-rank test p value 0·35; hazard ratio 1·16 [95% CI 0·82-1·64]). The most frequent adverse events, fevers, coughs, and colds, did not differ between groups.
abstract.textZh: 在2017年1月3日至2020年11月30日期間，篩選了984名兒童的資格， 162名被排除， 822名被隨機分配（ 411名為OM-85介入組， 411名為安慰劑組）。492名參與者為男性（ 59.9 ％ ） ， 330名（ 40.1 ％ ）為女性，參與者的平均年齡為11.8個月（ SD 3.8 ）。681名兒童完成了24個月的治療期， 596名兒童完成了36個月的觀察期。132名兒童在觀察期間至少經歷了一次喘鳴下呼吸道疾病； OM-85組的342名兒童中有71名（ 21 ％ ） ，安慰劑組的339名中有61名（ 18 ％ ）。OM-85和安慰劑之間在首次喘息下呼吸道疾病的時間方面沒有顯著差異（對數秩檢測p值0 · 35 ；風險比1 · 16 [95% CI 0 · 82-1 · 64] ）。各組之間最常見的不良事件（發燒、咳嗽和感冒）沒有差異。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Oral administration of OM-85 in early life did not decrease the incidence of wheezing lower respiratory tract illness in this high-risk population. Bacterial lysates are not efficacious for the primary prevention of asthma-like symptoms during the preschool years.
abstract.textZh: 在生命早期口服OM-85並未降低此高風險人羣中喘息下呼吸道疾病的發生率。細菌裂解物在學齡前期對哮喘樣症狀的初級預防無效。

articles.title: Discontinuation of β-blockers in stable patients with previous myocardial infarction, preserved left ventricular ejection fraction, and no heart failure: a pooled analysis of individual patient data
articles.authors: Silvain J, Choi KH, Monguillon V, Kang D, Cayla G, Kim W, Ferrari E, Song YB, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Many stable patients with chronic coronary syndrome continue β-blocker therapy for years after a myocardial infarction, despite having no clear ongoing indication. Whether β-blockers can be safely discontinued in such patients remains uncertain. The objective of this analysis was to assess the non-inferiority of β-blocker discontinuation versus continuation in patients with previous myocardial infarction and no remaining indication.
abstract.textZh: 儘管沒有明確的持續適應症，但許多穩定的慢性冠狀動脈綜合症患者在心肌梗塞後繼續β受體阻斷劑治療多年。在這類患者中是否可以安全停用β受體阻斷劑仍不確定。本分析的目的是評估既往有心肌梗塞且無剩餘適應症的患者停用β受體阻斷劑與繼續停用β受體阻斷劑的非劣效性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We performed a pooled analysis of individual patient data from the ABYSS and SMART-DECISION randomised trials in stable patients over 6 months after a myocardial infarction with a left ventricular ejection fraction of ≥40% and no heart failure. Non-inferiority was assessed for the composite primary endpoint of all-cause death, myocardial infarction, stroke, or hospitalisation for cardiovascular reasons, and for the key secondary endpoint of all-cause death, myocardial infarction, or hospitalisation for heart failure. Analyses used a one-stage mixed-effects Cox proportional hazards model including trial as a random effect with margins of 1·25 for the primary endpoint and 1·40 for the key secondary endpoint. The review protocol was registered with PROSPERO, number CRD420261299839.
abstract.textZh: 我們對來自ABYSS和SMART-DECISION隨機試驗的個體患者數據進行了匯總分析，這些試驗是在左心室射血分數≥ 40%且無心力衰竭的心肌梗塞後超過6個月的穩定患者中進行的。評估全因死亡、心肌梗塞、中風或因心血管原因住院的複合主要終點，以及全因死亡、心肌梗塞或因心力衰竭住院的關鍵次要終點的非劣效性。分析使用一階段混合效應Cox比例風險模型，包括作為隨機效應的試驗，主要終點的邊際值為1 · 25 ，關鍵次要終點的邊際值為1 · 40。審查方案在PROSPERO註冊，編號為CRD420261299839。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Among 6238 patients (3698 from ABYSS and 2540 from SMART-DECISION), 3092 were assigned to β-blocker discontinuation and 3146 to continuation. Median time from index myocardial infarction to randomisation was 3·6 years (IQR 1·6-7·5) and median follow-up was 3·0 years (2·3-3·8). The primary endpoint occurred in 532 (17·2%) of 3092 patients in the β-blocker discontinuation group and 500 (15·9%) of 3146 in the continuation group (hazard ratio 1·09 [95% CI 0·97-1·24]; pnon-inferiority=0·016). The key secondary endpoint occurred in 201 (6·5%) of 3092 patients in the discontinuation group and 201 (6·4%) of 3146 patients in the continuation group (1·01 [0·83-1·23]; pnon-inferiority=0·0006). Findings were consistent irrespective of background left ventricular ejection fraction.
abstract.textZh: 在6238名患者（ 3698名來自ABYSS ， 2540名來自SMART-DECISION ）中， 3092名被分配停用β受體阻斷劑， 3146名被分配繼續服用。從指標性心肌梗死到隨機分配的中位時間為3.6年（ IQR 1.6-7.5 ） ，中位隨訪時間為3.0年（ 2.3-3.8 ）。主要終點發生在β受體阻斷劑停藥組的3092名患者中的532名（ 17.2% ）和繼續治療組的3146名患者中的500名（ 15.9% ） （風險比1 · 09 [95% CI 0 · 97-1 · 24] ；非劣效性= 0 · 016 ）。關鍵次要終點發生在停藥組的3092名患者中的201名（ 6.5 ％ ）和繼續組的3146名患者中的201名（ 6.4 ％ ） （ 1 · 01 [0 · 83-1 · 23] ；非劣效性= 0 · 0006 ）。無論左心室背景射血分數如何，結果都是一致的。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: In stable patients with previous myocardial infarction, left ventricular ejection fraction ≥40%, no heart failure, and no other indication for β-blocker therapy, discontinuation met the non-inferiority criteria for the primary and key secondary endpoints. Interpretation of the primary endpoint is limited by its hospitalisation-heavy and trial-dependent composition.

articles.title: Esophageal Cancer
articles.authors: Xie SH, Smyth E, Lagergren J

abstract.text: Cancer of the esophagus is the thirteenth most common cancer and the seventh leading cause of cancer-related death worldwide, resulting in approximately 500,000 deaths annually. Population-based 5-year survival has improved in recent decades but rarely exceeds 20%. The main histologic types of esophageal cancer, adenocarcinoma and squamous-cell carcinoma, have different incidence patterns. The past four decades have witnessed a rapidly increasing incidence of esophageal adenocarcinoma in many Western countries, especially among White men, and a decreasing incidence of esophageal squamous-cell carcinoma. In contrast, the opposite is true for most other populations, in which esophageal squamous-cell carcinoma remains the most frequent form. This review focuses on recent developments in the epidemiologic characteristics, risk factors, prevention, and clinical management of esophageal cancer.
abstract.textZh: 食道癌是全球第十三大常見癌症和第七大癌症相關死亡原因，每年導致約50萬人死亡。近幾十年來，以人羣為基礎的5年生存率有所改善，但很少超過20%。食管癌、腺癌和鱗狀細胞癌的主要組織學類型具有不同的發病模式。過去四十年來，許多西方國家的食管腺癌發病率迅速增加，特別是白人男性，食管鱗狀細胞癌發病率下降。相反，對於大多數其他人羣來說情況正好相反，其中食管鱗狀細胞癌仍然是最常見的形式。本綜述著重於食管癌的流行病學特徵、風險因素、預防和臨牀管理的最新發展。

articles.title: Trial of a Maternal Diet Rich in Eggs and Peanuts to Reduce Infant Allergy
articles.authors: Palmer DJ, Campbell DE, Nanan R, Hsu PS, Jorgensen AM, O'Sullivan M, Netting MJ, McWilliam V, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Immune responses leading to food allergy may develop early in life, potentially before the introduction of solid foods. Exposures to food allergens in utero and through breast milk have been proposed as a strategy to prevent food allergies in infants, but evidence from randomized trials is lacking.
abstract.textZh: 導致食物過敏的免疫反應可能會在生命早期發生，可能在引入固體食物之前。作為預防嬰兒食物過敏的策略，已提出在子宮內和通過母乳暴露於食物過敏原，但缺乏隨機試驗的證據。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this multisite, randomized trial, pregnant women whose unborn child had at least two biologic family members with medically diagnosed allergic disease were eligible to participate. Participants were assigned in a 1:1 ratio to follow either a diet high in eggs and peanuts that included at least 6 eggs and 60 peanuts per week (high egg-peanut group) or a standard (control) egg and peanut diet that included no more than 3 eggs and 30 peanuts per week (standard-diet group), from before 23 weeks' gestation until 4 months postnatally during lactation. The primary outcome was IgE-mediated egg or peanut allergy in the infant at 1 year of age.
abstract.textZh: 在這項多站點隨機試驗中，未出生的孩子至少有兩名患有醫學診斷過敏性疾病的生物學家庭成員的孕婦有資格參與。參與者以1 ： 1的比例被分配，從懷孕23週前到哺乳期間產後4個月，遵循高雞蛋和花生的飲食（高雞蛋-花生組）或標準（對照）雞蛋和花生飲食（每週不超過3個雞蛋和30個花生） （標準飲食組）。主要結果是1歲嬰兒的IgE介導的卵或花生過敏。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 1070 participants were assigned to the high egg-peanut group, and 1067 were assigned to the standard-diet group. There was no significant difference in the percentage of infants with IgE-mediated egg or peanut allergy between the maternal high egg-peanut group (83 of 1066, 7.8%) and the standard-diet group (89 of 1064, 8.4%) (relative risk, 0.93; 95% confidence interval, 0.69 to 1.26; P = 0.65). Safety measures were similar in the two groups.
abstract.textZh: 共有1070名參與者被分配到高雞蛋花生組， 1067名被分配到標準飲食組。母體高雞蛋花生組（ 83/1066 ， 7.8% ）和標準飲食組（ 89/1064 ， 8.4% ）之間， IgE介導的卵子或花生過敏的嬰兒百分比沒有顯著差異（相對風險， 0.93 ； 95%置信區間， 0.69至1.26 ； P = 0.65 ）。兩組的安全措施相似。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: The ingestion of high amounts of egg and peanut during pregnancy and lactation did not result in a significantly lower risk of the development of egg or peanut allergy in infants by 1 year of age than ingestion of low amounts of these foods. (Funded by the Australian National Health and Medical Research Council and others; PrEggNut Australian New Zealand Clinical Trial Registry number, ACTRN12618000937213.).
abstract.textZh: 在懷孕和哺乳期間攝入大量的雞蛋和花生並沒有導致嬰兒在1歲時發生雞蛋或花生過敏的風險顯著低於攝入少量這些食物。（由澳大利亞國家衛生和醫學研究委員會及其他機構資助； PrEggNut澳大利亞新西蘭臨牀試驗註冊號， ACTRN12618000937213。）。

articles.titleZh: 富含雞蛋和花生的母親飲食試驗，以減少嬰兒過敏

articles.title: Blinatumomab for Replacing Chemotherapy in Pediatric Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
articles.authors: Schrappe M, Locatelli F, Valsecchi MG, Zugmaier G, Vossen-Gajcy M, Starý J, Attarbaschi A, Möricke A, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Blinatumomab, a bispecific T-cell engager targeting the CD19 antigen on B cells, may offer an option to safely replace cycles of traditional chemotherapy in pediatric patients with newly diagnosed high-risk B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL).
abstract.textZh: Blinatumomab是一種針對B細胞上CD19抗原的雙特異性T細胞接合劑，可能為新診斷的高風險B細胞急性淋巴母細胞白血病（ ALL ）的兒科患者提供安全取代傳統化療週期的選擇。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We randomly assigned, in a 1:1 ratio, children with high-risk B-cell ALL to receive two cycles of blinatumomab (blinatumomab group) or two cycles of chemotherapy (control group) after consolidation. The primary end point was event-free survival as evaluated in a time-to-event analysis; the duration of event-free survival was defined as the time from randomization to the first event among resistance to protocol treatment, relapse, second cancer, or death from any cause. Our primary objective was to evaluate whether the 4-year event-free survival would be 10 percentage points higher in the blinatumomab group than in the control group.
abstract.textZh: 我們以1 ： 1的比例隨機分配患有高風險B細胞ALL的兒童在鞏固後接受兩個週期的blinatumomab （ blinatumomab組）或兩個週期的化療（對照組）。主要終點是從時間到事件分析中評估的無事件生存期；無事件生存期的持續時間定義為從隨機分組到第一次事件之間對計畫書治療、復發、第二次癌症或任何原因死亡的抗藥性的時間。我們的主要目標是評估blinatumomab組的4年無事件生存率是否比對照組高10個百分點。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Overall, 709 of 768 eligible patients (92.3%) underwent randomization; 358 were assigned to the blinatumomab group and 351 to the control group. A planned interim analysis at a median follow-up of 2.9 years showed an estimated 4-year event-free survival of 83.0% (95% confidence interval [CI], 77.4 to 87.4) in the blinatumomab group and 70.3% (95% CI, 63.8 to 75.9) in the control group (P = 0.0002 in an intention-to-treat analysis). The estimated hazard ratio for a primary end-point event (blinatumomab vs. control) was 0.51 (95% CI, 0.35 to 0.73) as assessed with a Cox model. Infection related to the trial treatment occurred in 23.9% of patients in the blinatumomab group and in 69.4% of those in the control group (P<0.001). Life-threatening adverse events occurred in 2 patients (0.5%) in the blinatumomab group, including one (in 0.3%) that was fatal, and in 16 patients (4.7%) in the control group. Neurotoxic events were reported in 12.0% and 3.2%, respectively (P<0.001). Cytokine release syndrome of grade 2 or higher occurred in 1.1% of patients in the blinatumomab group.
abstract.textZh: 總體而言， 768名合格患者中有709名（ 92.3% ）接受了隨機分組； 358名被分配到blinatumomab組， 351名分配到對照組。 中位隨訪2.9年的計劃期中分析顯示， blinatumomab組的4年無事件存活率估計為83.0% （ 95%置信區間[CI] ， 77.4至87.4 ） ，對照組為70.3% （ 95% CI ， 63.8至75.9 ） （意向性分析P = 0.0002 ）。 使用Cox模型評估的主要終點事件（ blinatumomab與對照）的估計風險比為0.51 （ 95% CI ， 0.35至0.73 ）。 與試驗治療相關的感染發生在blinatumomab組中23.9%的患者和對照組中69.4%的患者（ P < 0.001 ）。 危及生命的不良事件發生在blinatumomab組的2名患者（ 0.5 ％ ）中，其中1名（ 0.3 ％ ）為致命性不良事件，對照組的16名患者（ 4.7 ％ ）為致命性不良事件。 神經毒性事件的報告分別為12.0%和3.2% （ P < 0.001 ）。 Blinatumomab組中1.1%的患者發生2級或更高的細胞因子釋放綜合徵。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: In children with newly diagnosed high-risk B-cell ALL, replacement of two cycles of highly toxic conventional chemotherapy with blinatumomab resulted in a significantly greater percentage of patients with event-free survival at 4 years. (Funded by Deutsche Krebshilfe and others; AIEOP-BFM ALL 2017 EudraCT number, 2016-001935-12; EU Clinical Trials number, 2023-509856-32-00; and ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT03643276.).
abstract.textZh: 在新診斷為高風險B細胞ALL的兒童中，用blinatumomab取代兩個週期的高毒性常規化療，導致4年無事件生存率的患者百分比顯著增加。（由Deutsche Krebshilfe等人資助； AIEOP-BFM ALL 2017 EudraCT編號， 2016-001935-12 ；歐盟臨牀試驗編號， 2023-509856-32-00 ；以及ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT03643276。）。

articles.titleZh: Blinatumomab替代小兒急性淋巴母細胞白血病的化療

articles.title: Colonoscopy Intervals and Colorectal Cancer Incidence after Adenoma Removal
articles.authors: Jover R, Bretthauer M, Cubiella J, Barry SJE, Macios A, Barnett L, Erichsen R, Kaminski MF, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: More evidence is needed to inform recommendations for intervals of colonoscopy surveillance after polyp removal.
abstract.textZh: 需要更多證據來提供有關息肉切除後結腸鏡檢查監測間隔的建議。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this ongoing noninferiority trial conducted in eight European countries, we randomly assigned patients with high-risk adenomas (defined as ≥1 adenoma with a diameter of ≥10 mm, high-grade dysplasia, or villous growth or 3 to 10 adenomas of any kind) to undergo a first colonoscopy at 5 years after polyp removal or at 3 years; surveillance at 3 years is currently recommended in guidelines. The 3-year group also underwent colonoscopy at 5 years. The primary end point is the cumulative incidence of colorectal cancer at 10 years, with a prespecified noninferiority margin of 0.7 percentage points for the upper boundary of the confidence interval for the difference between the two groups. Here, we report the results of an interim analysis conducted after 5.5 years of follow-up. Inverse probability weighting was used to account for missing data owing to nonparticipation in surveillance colonoscopy at 5 years. In this analysis, the incidence of colorectal cancer is reported with a one-sided 99.12% confidence interval; for the final analysis at 10 years, the plan is to calculate a 95.33% confidence interval to maintain an overall type I error of 5%.
abstract.textZh: 在這項正在八個歐洲國家進行的非劣效性試驗中，我們隨機分配高風險腺瘤患者（定義為直徑≥ 10 mm的≥ 1個腺瘤、高度發育異常或絨毛生長或3至10個任何類型的腺瘤）在息肉切除後5年或3年時進行首次結腸鏡檢查；目前建議在3年時進行監測。 3年組在5年時也接受了結腸鏡檢查。 主要終點是大腸直腸癌在10年的累積發病率，兩組之間差異的置信區間的上界預先規定的非劣效性邊際為0.7個百分點。 在這裡，我們報告了5.5年隨訪後進行的期中分析的結果。 反向機率加權用於解釋由於在5年內未參與監測結腸鏡檢查而導致的數據缺失。 在本分析中，結直腸癌的發病率以單側99.12%的置信區間報告；對於10年的最終分析，計劃是計算95.33%的置信區間，以維持5%的整體I型錯誤。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 10,799 patients underwent randomization: 5398 patients were assigned to the 5-year group and 5401 to the 3-year group. The 5-year cumulative incidence of colorectal cancer was 0.77% with less-frequent surveillance and 0.82% with more-frequent surveillance (difference, -0.05 percentage points); the upper boundary of the 99.12% confidence interval was 0.68, which met the criterion for noninferiority. The distribution of cancer stage at diagnosis did not appear to differ substantially between the two groups. A total of 5 patients died of colorectal cancer: 3 patients (0.06%) in the 5-year group and 2 (0.04%) in the 3-year group.
abstract.textZh: 共有10,799名患者接受了隨機分組： 5398名患者被分配到5年組， 5401名患者被分配到3年組。結直腸癌的5年累計發病率為0.77% (監測頻率較低)和0.82% (監測頻率較高) (差異為-0.05個百分點) ； 99.12%置信區間的上界為0.68 ，符合非劣效性標準。診斷時的癌症分期分佈似乎在兩組之間沒有顯著差異。共有5名患者死於大腸癌： 5年組3名患者（ 0.06% ） ， 3年組2名患者（ 0.04% ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: In this interim analysis of a 10-year noninferiority trial, beginning surveillance colonoscopy at 5 years after polyp removal was noninferior to beginning at 3 years with respect to the cumulative incidence of colorectal cancer at 5 years among patients with high-risk adenomas. (Funded by the Research Council of Norway and others; EPoS II ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT02319928.).
abstract.textZh: 在這項為期 10 年的非劣效性試驗的中期分析中，對於高風險腺瘤患者，息肉切除後 5 年開始進行監測性大腸鏡檢查，在 5 年內結直腸癌累積發病率方面，不劣於 3 年開始進行監測性大腸鏡檢查。 （由挪威研究理事會和其他機構資助；EPoS II ClinicalTrials.gov 編號：NCT02319928。）

articles.titleZh: 腺瘤切除後大腸鏡檢查間隔和結腸直腸癌發病率

articles.title: Sodium Bicarbonate for Critically Ill Adults with Metabolic Acidosis and Shock
articles.authors: SODa-BIC Investigators and the Australian and New Zealand Intensive Care Society Clinical Trials Group, Serpa Neto A, McNamara M, White K, Cooper DJ, Fujii T, Higgins AM, Hodgson CL, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Metabolic acidosis is common in critically ill patients and is associated with organ dysfunction and death. Sodium bicarbonate is used to correct acidemia, but its benefit in patients with metabolic acidosis who are receiving vasopressors remains uncertain.
abstract.textZh: 代謝性酸中毒在危重症患者中很常見，並且與器官功能障礙和死亡有關。碳酸氫鈉用於糾正酸血症，但其對正在接受血管加壓藥的代謝性酸中毒患者的益處仍不確定。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this pragmatic, adaptive, double-blind, randomized trial, we assigned adults with metabolic acidosis (pH, <7.30; base excess, no more than -4 mmol per liter; and partial pressure of arterial carbon dioxide, ≤45 mm Hg without intubation or ≤50 mm Hg with intubation) who were receiving vasopressors in the intensive care unit (ICU) to receive either sodium bicarbonate or placebo (5% dextrose). Sodium bicarbonate or placebo was infused for up to 5 hours, with the infusion rate adjusted for a target pH of at least 7.30 and base excess of at least 0 mmol per liter. The primary outcome was a major adverse kidney event, defined as death, use of renal-replacement therapy, or persistent renal dysfunction, within 30 days.
abstract.textZh: 在這項務實、適應性、雙盲、隨機試驗中，我們將在重症監護病房（ ICU ）接受血管加壓藥物的代謝性酸中毒（ pH < 7.30 ；鹼基過量，每升不超過-4 mmol ；動脈二氧化碳分壓，未插管時≤ 45 mm Hg或插管時≤ 50 mm Hg ）的成年人分配接受碳酸氫鈉或安慰劑（ 5%葡萄糖）。將碳酸氫鈉或安慰劑輸注長達5小時，輸注速率調整為目標pH值至少為7.30 ，鹼基過量至少為0 mmol/升。主要結果是30天內的重大腎臟不良事件，定義為死亡、使用腎臟替代療法或持續性腎功能障礙。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 500 patients were enrolled in 55 ICUs across seven countries; 245 patients were assigned to receive sodium bicarbonate and 255 to receive placebo. A major adverse kidney event within 30 days occurred in 98 of 244 patients (40.2%) in the sodium bicarbonate group and in 100 of 254 patients (39.4%) in the placebo group (adjusted difference, 1.2 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -7.1 to 9.4; P = 0.78). Renal-replacement therapy was used within 30 days in 16.8% of the patients in the sodium bicarbonate group and in 20.9% of those in the placebo group (adjusted difference, -3.9 percentage points; 95% CI, -10.6 to 2.7). In-hospital mortality by day 30 was 25.4% in the sodium bicarbonate group and 24.0% in the placebo group (adjusted difference, 1.8 percentage points; 95% CI, -5.6 to 9.2). Four patients (1.6%) in the sodium bicarbonate group had an adverse effect, as compared with none in the placebo group (P = 0.06).
abstract.textZh: 共有500名患者在7個國家的55個ICU中入組； 245名患者被分配接受碳酸氫鈉治療， 255名患者被分配接受安慰劑治療。碳酸氫鈉組的244名患者中有98名（ 40.2% ）和安慰劑組的254名患者中有100名（ 39.4% ）在30天內發生了重大不良腎臟事件（調整差異， 1.2個百分點； 95%置信區間[CI] ， -7.1至9.4 ； P = 0.78 ）。碳酸氫鈉組中16.8%的患者和安慰劑組中20.9%的患者在30天內使用了腎臟替代療法（調整差異， -3.9個百分點； 95% CI ， -10.6至2.7 ）。第30天的院內死亡率在碳酸氫鈉組中為25.4% ，在安慰劑組中為24.0% （調整差異， 1.8個百分點； 95% CI ， -5.6至9.2 ）。碳酸氫鈉組有4名患者(1.6%)出現不良反應，而安慰劑組則沒有(P = 0.06)。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: The use of sodium bicarbonate in critically ill patients with metabolic acidosis receiving vasopressors did not lead to a lower risk of major adverse kidney events within 30 days than placebo. (Funded by the National Health and Medical Research Council of Australia; SODa-BIC ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05697770.).
abstract.textZh: 在接受血管加壓藥物的代謝性酸中毒危重症患者中使用碳酸氫鈉並未導致30天內發生重大不良腎臟事件的風險低於安慰劑。（由澳大利亞國家衛生和醫學研究委員會資助； SODa-BIC ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT05697770。）。

articles.titleZh: 用於患有代謝性酸中毒和休克的重症成人的碳酸氫鈉

articles.title: Intrauterine Mepivacaine Instillation vs Placebo for Pain During IUD Placement: A Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Elgemark K, Envall N, Kopp Kallner H

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Concern about pain during intrauterine device (IUD) placement is common and reduces selection of an IUD. Reducing procedure-related pain may support informed contraceptive decision-making and patient autonomy and has also been associated with improved patient satisfaction and procedural experience.
abstract.textZh: 關注宮內節育器（ IUD ）放置期間的疼痛是常見的，並減少了IUD的選擇。減少與手術相關的疼痛可以支持明智的避孕決策和患者自主性，並且還與改善患者滿意度和手術體驗有關。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To determine whether intrauterine instillation of mepivacaine reduces pain during IUD placement in nulliparous individuals.
abstract.textZh: 確定子宮內灌注mepivacaine是否減輕未產個體在IUD放置期間的疼痛。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Multicenter, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial conducted at 11 outpatient gynecology, maternal health, and youth clinics in Sweden from May 2021 through June 2024. Nulliparous individuals aged 18 to 31 years opting for IUDs with smaller-diameter placement tubes (levonorgestrel 19.5 mg, 13.5 mg, or copper IUD) were eligible. Key exclusion criteria included ongoing pregnancy, IUD replacement, pelvic infection, and allergy to local anesthetics. A total of 370 participants were randomized.
abstract.textZh: 2021年5月至2024年6月在瑞典11家門診婦科、孕產婦健康和青年診所進行的多中心、雙盲、隨機、安慰劑對照試驗。年齡介於18至31歲的未生育者選擇使用直徑較小的置管（左炔諾孕酮19.5毫克、13.5毫克或銅製IUD ）的IUD符合資格。關鍵排除標準包括持續懷孕、宮內節育器更換、盆腔感染和對局部麻醉劑過敏。共有370名參與者被隨機分配。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Participants were randomly assigned (1:1) (185 per group) to intrauterine instillation of 10 mL of mepivacaine (20 mg/mL) or sodium chloride (9 mg/mL) via a hydrosonography catheter 2 minutes before IUD placement. Participants, clinicians, and outcome assessors were blinded to treatment allocation.
abstract.textZh: 將參與者隨機分配(1: 1) (每組185人) ，在放置IUD前2分鐘，透過超聲導管，在子宮內注射10毫升mepivacaine (20毫克/毫升)或氯化鈉(9毫克/毫升)。參與者、臨牀醫生和結果評估者對治療分配視而不見。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary outcome was clinician-adjusted difference in pain scores during IUD placement, measured on a 100-mm visual analog scale. The primary analysis included all randomized participants with available primary outcome data. Prespecified secondary analyses included tolerability and overall experience.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果是以100毫米視覺類比量表測量的IUD放置期間臨牀醫生調整的疼痛評分差異。主要療效分析包括所有具有可用主要療效結果資料的隨機分組參與者。預先指定的次要療效分析包括耐受性和整體經驗。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 370 participants were randomized. Mean age was 21.7 (SD, 3.0) years in the mepivacaine group and 21.7 (SD, 2.9) years in the placebo group. Mean pain score during IUD placement was 43.8 mm (SD, 24.7) in the mepivacaine group and 58.6 mm (SD, 21.5) in the placebo group (mean difference, 14.8 mm [95% CI, 10.0-19.6]; P < .001). Adjustment for individual clinician yielded similar results (mean difference, 14.2 mm [95% CI, 9.7-18.6]; P < .001). Tolerable pain was reported by 172 of 175 participants (98.3%) in the mepivacaine group and 159 of 174 (91.4%) in the placebo group (relative risk, 1.08 [95% CI, 1.02-1.13]; NNT, 15 [95% CI, 9-43]).
abstract.textZh: 共有370名參與者被隨機分配。mepivacaine組的平均年齡為21.7 (SD, 3.0)歲，安慰劑組的平均年齡為21.7 (SD, 2.9)歲。在IUD放置期間， mepivacaine組的平均疼痛評分為43.8 mm (SD ， 24.7) ，安慰劑組的平均疼痛評分為58.6 mm (SD ， 21.5) (平均差異， 14.8 mm [95% CI ， 10.0-19.6] ； P < 0.001)。個別臨牀醫生的調整產生了類似的結果（平均差， 14.2 mm [95% CI ， 9.7-18.6] ； P < 0.001 ）。Mepivacaine組175名參與者中有172名（ 98.3% ）報告了可忍受的疼痛，安慰劑組174名參與者中有159名（ 91.4% ）報告了可忍受的疼痛（相對風險， 1.08 [95% CI ， 1.02-1.13] ； NNT ， 15 [95% CI ， 9-43] ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: Intrauterine instillation of 10 mL of mepivacaine (20 mg/mL) significantly reduced pain and improved tolerability during IUD placement compared with instillation of placebo saline.
abstract.textZh: 與安慰劑生理鹽水的滴注相比， 10 mL mepivacaine （ 20 mg/mL ）的宮內滴注顯著減輕了IUD放置期間的疼痛並改善了耐受性。

articles.title: Revascularization of Asymptomatic Carotid Artery Stenosis: Cognitive Results of the CREST-2 Randomized Trials
articles.authors: Lazar RM, Meschia JF, Edwards LJ, Lal BK, Howard G, Storm E, Heck D, Mena-Hurtado C, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Studies show that asymptomatic carotid artery stenosis is associated with diminished cognition. Whether carotid revascularization leads to cognitive improvement is unclear.
abstract.textZh: 研究表明，無症狀的頸動脈狹窄與認知能力下降有關。頸動脈血運重建是否會導致認知改善尚不清楚。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To determine whether carotid revascularization improves cognition.
abstract.textZh: 確定頸動脈血運重建是否改善認知。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Prespecified cognitive secondary outcomes of the CREST-2 randomized clinical trials of patients 35 years or older with 70% or greater asymptomatic carotid stenosis. Enrollment was December 2014 through July 2024, and follow-up ended July 2025. Five cognitive tests were administered before treatment and annually up to 4 years. Cognitive performances from 146 clinical sites were centrally assessed by telephone, blinded to treatment.
abstract.textZh: 35歲或以上無症狀頸動脈狹窄患者的CREST-2隨機臨牀試驗的預先指定認知次要結果。入組日期為2014年12月至2024年7月，追蹤截止日期為2025年7月。在治療前進行了五次認知測試，每年進行長達4年。來自146個臨牀中心的認知表現通過電話集中評估，對治療視而不見。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Two trials compared carotid stenting plus intensive medical management (CAS + IMM) with IMM alone and carotid endarterectomy plus IMM (CEA + IMM) with IMM alone.
abstract.textZh: 兩項試驗比較了頸動脈支架置入加強化醫療管理（ CAS + IMM ）與單獨IMM ，以及頸動脈內膜切除加IMM （ CEA + IMM ）與單獨IMM。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: Five cognitive tests, assessing learning, memory, executive function, attention, and processing speed, administered to all patients, were assessed for unadjusted and adjusted mean z scores using a linear mixed model. The minimal clinically important difference was 0.50 SD between treatment groups. The prespecified primary analysis was the fully adjusted composite z score at 4 years. Secondary analyses assessed the individual tests and at the test intervals.
abstract.textZh: 使用線性混合模型評估五項認知測試，評估所有患者的學習、記憶、執行功能、注意力和處理速度，以評估未調整和調整的平均z分數。治療組之間的最小臨牀重要差異為0.50 SD。預先指定的主要分析是4年時完全調整的綜合z評分。次要療效分析評估了個別測試和測試間隔。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 2366 US study patients, 2165 (91.5%) participated in cognitive assessments, 1078 in the CAS trial (529 CAS + IMM; 549 IMM alone) and 1087 in the CEA trial (543 CEA + IMM; 544 IMM alone); mean age was 70.1 years (SD, 7.7) and 37.8% were female. Following baseline, 4954 test batteries were administered for a mean of 2.24 (SD, 1.09) follow-up years. There were no treatment-related differences in the fully adjusted estimated composite z scores at 4 years for either the CAS trial (CAS + IMM, 0.22 [95% CI, 0.13 to 0.30] vs IMM alone, 0.18 [95% CI, 0.09 to 0.27]; between-group difference, 0.03 [95% CI, -0.09 to 0.15]) or the CEA trial (CEA + IMM, 0.25 [95% CI, 0.17 to 0.33] vs IMM, 0.23 [95% CI, 0.15 to 0.32]; between-group difference, 0.02 [95% CI, -0.09 to 0.14]). There were no significant differences between revascularization plus medical management vs IMM alone for any individual cognitive test.
abstract.textZh: 在2366名美國研究患者中， 2165名（ 91.5% ）參與認知評估， CAS試驗中為1078名（ 529名CAS + IMM ；單獨549名IMM ） ， CEA試驗中為1087名（ 543名CEA + IMM ；單獨544名IMM ） ；平均年齡為70.1歲（ SD ， 7.7 ） ，女性為37.8%。在基線期後，平均使用4954個測試電池2.24 (SD, 1.09)個隨訪年。CAS試驗（ CAS + IMM ， 0.22 [95% CI ， 0.13至0.30] vs IMM單獨， 0.18 [95% CI ， 0.09至0.27] ；組間差異， 0.03 [95% CI ， -0.09至0.15] ）或CEA試驗（ CEA + IMM ， 0.25 [95% CI ， 0.17至0.33] vs IMM ， 0.23 [95% CI ， 0.15至0.32] ；組間差異， 0.02 [95% CI ， -0.09至0.14] ）在4年時，完全調整的估計綜合z評分沒有治療相關差異。對於任何個體認知測試，血管重建加上醫療管理與單獨IMM之間沒有顯著差異。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: In patients with severe asymptomatic carotid artery stenosis, revascularization with either CAS or CEA plus IMM, compared with IMM alone, did not significantly improve cognitive function at up to 4 years of follow-up.
abstract.textZh: 在嚴重無症狀頸動脈狹窄的患者中，與單獨使用IMM相比，使用CAS或CEA + IMM進行血管重建，在長達4年的隨訪中並未顯著改善認知功能。

articles.title: Revascularization in Asymptomatic Carotid Artery Stenosis With Hemodynamic Impairment and Cognitive Outcomes: The CREST-H Substudy of the CREST-2 Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Marshall RS, Lazar RM, Meschia JF, Huston J, Edwards LJ, Brott TG, Lal BK, Howard G, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Cerebral hemodynamic impairment in patients with asymptomatic internal carotid artery (ICA) stenosis is associated with reduced cognition. It is uncertain whether revascularization might be an effective treatment for cognitive impairment in these patients.
abstract.textZh: 無症狀性頸內動脈（ ICA ）狹窄患者的腦血液動力學損傷與認知能力下降有關。目前尚不確定血管重建是否可以有效治療這些患者的認知障礙。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To test whether any cognitive benefit from revascularization of high-grade, asymptomatic ICA stenosis varies based on the degree of baseline cerebral hemodynamic impairment.
abstract.textZh: 為了測試高度無症狀ICA狹窄的血管重建是否有任何認知益處，根據基線時腦血液動力學損傷的程度而有所不同。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: This substudy was conducted within a multicenter phase 3 randomized clinical trial. Adults (aged 35-86 years) without dementia with eighth-grade education or higher and unilateral asymptomatic ICA stenosis greater than or equal to 70% were enrolled from January 2018 to July 2024 at 61 sites in North America (last follow-up in July 2025). Of 607 participants screened from 2485 in CREST-2, 392 were enrolled. Magnetic resonance or computed tomographic perfusion imaging tested for baseline hemodynamic impairment defined by delayed time-to-peak (TTP) arrival of intravenous contrast in the hemisphere ipsilateral minus contralateral to the stenotic artery.
abstract.textZh: 本子研究是在多中心3期隨機臨牀試驗中進行的。從2018年1月到2024年7月，在北美的61個研究中心招募了沒有失智症、受過八年級以上教育且單側無症狀ICA狹窄大於或等於70 ％的成年人（年齡在35-86歲之間） （最後一次隨訪於2025年7月）。在2485名CREST-2篩選的607名參與者中，有392人入組。磁共振或電腦斷層掃描灌注成像測試基線血液動力學損傷，定義為靜脈造影劑延遲到達半球同側減去狹窄動脈對側。

abstract.label: INTERVENTION
abstract.text: Carotid revascularization (endarterectomy or stenting) plus intensive medical management (IMM) vs IMM alone.
abstract.textZh: 頸動脈血運重建（動脈內切除術或支架置入術）加強化醫療管理（ IMM ）與單獨使用IMM。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary outcome was the difference in composite cognitive z score over 1 year based on 5 cognitive tests. The primary analysis tested for an interaction between treatment group (revascularization vs IMM alone) and degree of baseline hemodynamic impairment among those with reduced baseline cognition (cognitive z score ≤-1.0 SD).
abstract.textZh: 主要結果是根據5項認知測試得出的1年內綜合認知z分數的差異。主要療效分析測試了治療組之間的相互作用（血運重建與單獨IMM ）和基線血液動力學損傷程度之間的相互作用（基線認知能力降低（認知z分數≤ -1.0 SD ）。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of 392 participants enrolled (mean age, 71 years; 125 [32%] females), 61 were excluded for missing baseline imaging and 40 for missing cognitive examinations or other covariates, leaving 291 with complete data. Fifty-one had reduced cognition at baseline (25 in the revascularization group and 26 in the IMM alone group). TTP ranged from no interhemispheric TTP delay to a more-than-2-second delay. Mean (SD) cognitive z scores were -1.36 (0.51) at baseline and -1.17 (0.47) at 1 year in the revascularization group and -1.34 (0.83) at baseline and -1.01 (0.97) at 1 year in the IMM alone group. The primary analysis showed no difference in cognition by treatment group over 1 year, adjusting for treatment group × hemodynamic status interaction and other covariates (adjusted difference in cognitive z score, -0.15 SD [95% CI, -0.54 to 0.24]). The interaction was not significant (β estimate = 0.018 [95% CI, -0.025 to 0.061]; P = .40).
abstract.textZh: 在入組的392名參與者（平均年齡71歲； 125名[32%]女性）中， 61名因缺少基線影像學檢查而被排除， 40名因缺少認知檢查或其他協變量而被排除，留下291份完整數據。51例患者在基線時認知能力下降（血運重建組25例，單獨IMM組26例）。TTP範圍從沒有半球間TTP延遲到超過2秒延遲。基線時的平均(SD)認知z評分為-1.36 (0.51) ，血運重建組為-1.17 (0.47) ，基線時為-1.34 (0.83) ，單獨IMM組為-1.01 (0.97)。主要療效分析表明， 1年內各治療組的認知沒有差異，調整治療組×血液動力學狀態相互作用和其他協變量(調整後的認知z評分差異， -0.15 SD [95% CI ， -0.54至0.24])。相互作用不顯著（ β估計值= 0.018 [95% CI ， -0.025至0.061] ； P = 0.40 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: In this substudy of a randomized clinical trial, there was no differential effect of revascularization vs IMM alone on cognition over 1 year by cerebral hemodynamic status among those with baseline reduced cognition, suggesting that revascularization does not improve cognitive dysfunction by restoring flow to the brain in chronic asymptomatic carotid stenosis.
abstract.textZh: 在這項隨機臨牀試驗的子研究中，在基線期認知能力降低的人羣中，血運重建與單獨IMM在1年內對認知能力的影響沒有差異，這表明血運重建不會通過在慢性無症狀性頸動脈狹窄中恢復流向大腦來改善認知功能障礙。

articles.title: Sustaining named GP continuity requires organisational change: a comparative implementation analysis in Finland
articles.authors: Tuompo W, Mäkelä J, Timonen M, Auvinen J

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Maintaining doctor-patient relationship continuity remains a challenge in public primary care in Finland and internationally owing to GP workforce pressures and organisational constraints.
abstract.textZh: 由於全科醫生的勞動力壓力和組織限制，維持醫患關係的連續性仍然是芬蘭和國際公共初級保健的挑戰。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To evaluate implementation of a named GP model and explain differences in implementation outcomes between two Finnish primary care units.
abstract.textZh: 評估指定的全科醫生模式的實施情況，並解釋芬蘭兩個初級保健單位之間實施結果的差異。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A quasi-experimental before-after study was conducted in two Finnish primary care units with contrasting organisational settings. Patients were assigned a named GP responsible for non-urgent care. Electronic health record data covering physician consultations over 48 months were analysed.
abstract.textZh: 在兩個芬蘭初級保健單位中進行了準實驗性事前事後研究，組織環境形成對比。患者被指派負責非緊急護理的指定全科醫生。分析了涵蓋48個月內醫師會診的電子健康記錄數據。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Continuity was measured using the Usual Provider of Care (UPC) Index, the St Leonard's Index of Continuity of Care (SLICC), and the Own Patient Ratio (OPR). Implementation outcomes were interpreted using the RE-AIM framework. A segmented interrupted time series model was applied to OPR and SLICC, and UPC analysed using a pre-post design.
abstract.textZh: 使用普通護理提供者（ UPC ）指數、聖倫納德護理持續性指數（ SLICC ）和自身患者比率（ OPR ）來測量連續性。實施結果使用RE-AIM框架來解釋。將分段中斷時間序列模型應用於OPR和SLICC ，並使用前後設計分析UPC。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Named GP continuity was higher in Tuira than in Pudasjärvi across all measures. In Tuira, adoption (OPR 0.88) was high and stable with lower named GP-level variation, while reach (SLICC 0.31) and effectiveness (UPC 0.35) improved but remained modest. Although continuity improved in Pudasjärvi, adoption remained weaker (OPR 0.40), reach lower (SLICC 0.16), and maintenance less stable. Continuity of care with physicians other than the named GP increased more in Pudasjärvi.
abstract.textZh: 在所有措施中， Tuira的命名GP連續性都高於Pudasjärvi。在圖伊拉，採用率（ OPR 0.88 ）高且穩定， GP水平變化較低，而REACH （ SLICC 0.31 ）和有效性（ UPC 0.35 ）有所改善，但仍然適度。雖然Pudasjärvi的連續性有所改善，但採用率仍然較弱（ OPR 0.40 ） ，達到較低（ SLICC 0.16 ） ，維護不太穩定。在Pudasjärvi ，除了指定的全科醫生之外，其他醫生的持續護理增加更多。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: The named GP model was functionally adopted in Tuira but remained largely nominal in Pudasjärvi. Health systems implementing named GP models should prioritise sustained GP presence and organisational alignment to achieve continuity.
abstract.textZh: 命名的GP模型在Tuira功能上採用，但在Pudasjärvi基本上保持名義。實施指定GP模型的衛生系統應優先考慮持續的GP存在和組織一致性，以實現連續性。

articles.title: Evaluation and Management of Anemia in Chronic Kidney Disease: Synopsis of the Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes 2026 Clinical Practice Guideline
articles.authors: Hedayati SS, Babitt JL, Berns JS, Bozkurt B, Cheung RS, Cuevas Y, Effa EE, Eisenga MF, et al.

abstract.label: DESCRIPTION
abstract.text: The Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) 2026 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Anemia in Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) provides an update of the 2012 version. Its scope includes anemia diagnosis and use of iron therapy, erythropoiesis-stimulating agents (ESAs), hypoxia-inducible factor-prolyl hydroxylase inhibitors (HIF-PHIs), and red blood cell (RBC) transfusions to treat anemia in CKD.
abstract.textZh: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) 2026 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Anemia in Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD)提供了2012年版本的更新。其範圍包括貧血診斷和使用鐵療法、紅細胞生成刺激劑（ ESA ）、低氧誘導因子-脯氨酰羥化酶抑制劑（ HIF-PHI ）和紅細胞（ RBC ）輸血來治療CKD中的貧血。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: An international work group of patient partners, health care professionals, researchers, and clinicians defined the guideline scope. An independent evidence review team conducted systematic reviews through October 2024 and graded the certainty of evidence using the GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation) approach. The final guideline incorporated feedback from a public review involving registered stakeholders in late 2024.
abstract.textZh: 由患者合作夥伴、醫療保健專業人員、研究人員和臨牀醫生組成的國際工作小組確定了指南範圍。獨立證據審查團隊在2024年10月前進行了系統審查，並使用GRADE （建議評估、發展和評估的評分）方法對證據的確定性進行了評分。最終準則納入了2024年底由註冊利益相關者參與的公開評價意見。

abstract.label: RECOMMENDATIONS
abstract.text: This synopsis focuses on the 8 graded recommendations. Key points include the use of transferrin saturation and ferritin thresholds to guide iron therapy, with intravenous iron preferred over oral iron in people receiving hemodialysis; addressing correctable causes of anemia before use of an ESA or a HIF-PHI; using an ESA rather than a HIF-PHI as first-line treatment; individualized hemoglobin (Hb) thresholds for ESA initiation based on patient characteristics, symptoms, and values; and an upper Hb target of below 11.5 g/dL (<115 g/L) during ESA maintenance therapy. The guideline also includes 49 practice points representing expert consensus where robust evidence was limited or systematic review could not be conducted.
abstract.textZh: 本大綱重點介紹8項評分建議。關鍵點包括使用轉鐵蛋白飽和度和鐵蛋白閾值來指導鐵療法，在接受血液透析的人羣中，靜脈注射鐵優於口服鐵；在使用ESA或HIF-PHI之前解決貧血的可糾正原因；使用ESA而不是HIF-PHI作為一線治療；根據患者特徵、症狀和值， ESA啟動的個性化血紅蛋白(Hb)閾值；以及在ESA維持治療期間，血紅蛋白上限目標低於11.5 g/dL (< 115 g/L)。該指南還包括代表專家共識的49個實踐點，其中有力的證據有限或無法進行系統審查。

articles.title: A Synopsis of the 2025 U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and U.S. Department of Defense Clinical Practice Guideline for Lipid Management for Cardiovascular Disease Risk Reduction
articles.authors: Arnold MJ, Spacek L, Bush KNV, Waring AA, Ballard-Hernandez J, Beckman D, Kelley C, Natarajan S, et al.

abstract.label: DESCRIPTION
abstract.text: In December 2025, the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and the U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) released a clinical practice guideline (CPG) update on lipid management for cardiovascular disease risk reduction in adults. This synopsis reviews the 2025 updates and describes the major recommendations.
abstract.textZh: 2025年12月，美國退伍軍人事務部（ VA ）和美國國防部（ DoD ）發布了成人心血管疾病風險降低的血脂管理臨牀實踐指南（ CPG ）更新。本摘要回顧2025年的更新內容，並說明主要建議。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: The VA/DoD guideline development team updated the 2020 VA/DoD lipid management CPG with clinical stakeholders. The guideline panel developed 12 key questions, systematically evaluated the literature (English-language publications from 16 May 2019 to 15 January 2025), and developed 24 evidence-based recommendations. The recommendations were graded using the GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation) system.
abstract.textZh: 退伍軍人事務部/國防部指南開發團隊與臨牀利益相關者更新了2020年退伍軍人事務部/國防部血脂管理CPG。指南小組制定了12個關鍵問題，系統地評估了文獻（ 2019年5月16日至2025年1月15日的英文出版物） ，並制定了24個以證據為基礎的建議。使用GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation)系統對建議進行評分。

abstract.label: RECOMMENDATIONS
abstract.text: This synopsis highlights key recommendations for lipid management that are new or differ from other guideline recommendations. This update recommends the Predicting Risk of Cardiovascular Disease EVENTs (PREVENT) calculator for risk estimation in primary prevention and removes a previous recommendation against routine lipid monitoring. Two new risk refinement strategies were added: Coronary artery calcium testing is suggested for patients with clinical uncertainty and intermediate-to-high calculated risk, and one-time lipoprotein(a) testing is recommended to identify patients with enhanced cardiovascular risk. For primary prevention, moderate-intensity statins remain the recommended treatment for those at higher risk and should be considered for those at intermediate risk. A new recommendation suggests moderate-intensity statins for adults living with HIV even when 10-year risk is low. This update shifts toward more intensive lipid-lowering therapy for secondary prevention. For very high-risk patients with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, the guideline now suggests combination therapy with high-intensity or maximally tolerated statins plus ezetimibe and/or proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) inhibitors. For statin-intolerant patients, alternatives include bempedoic acid, ezetimibe, fibrates, or PCSK9 monoclonal antibody inhibitors.

articles.title: Influence of Physician Behaviors on How Patients Interpret Normal Test Results
articles.authors: Kube T, Seewald A

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Reassuring patients that nothing serious is wrong is one of the most common interventions in family medicine. However, medical reassurance can sometimes fail, and it is not yet clear what role the doctor's behavior plays in this regard. We tested the preregistered hypothesis that a doctor's warmth and competence significantly and independently influence patients' responses to normal results from diagnostic testing.
abstract.textZh: 向患者保證沒有任何嚴重問題是家庭醫學中最常見的幹預措施之一。然而，醫療保證有時會失敗，目前還不清楚醫生的行為在這方面扮演什麼角色。我們測試了預先註冊的假設，即醫生的溫暖和能力顯著且獨立地影響患者對診斷測試正常結果的反應。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We used an online convenience sample reporting medium somatic symptom burden (N = 349, mean age 29.9 years, 79% female) and completed an experimental analog study. After presentation of a symptom vignette, participants watched a videotaped medical report in which a doctor provided the results of diagnostic tests, stating that no abnormality had been identified. Whereas the diagnostic information was always the same, the doctor's behavior differed in terms of warmth (high vs low) and competence (high vs low).
abstract.textZh: 我們使用在線便利樣本報告中等軀體症狀負擔（ N = 349 ，平均年齡29.9歲， 79 ％為女性） ，並完成了一項實驗類比研究。在呈現症狀暈影後，參與者觀看了一份醫療報告錄像，其中醫生提供了診斷測試的結果，指出沒有發現異常。儘管診斷資訊始終相同，但醫生的行為在溫暖（高與低）和能力（高與低）方面有所不同。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Participants rated the likelihood of a serious disease significantly lower if the doctor showed high warmth and high competence. Further results showed that high warmth and competence also led to improvements in other outcomes, such as a lower desire to seek another doctor's opinion or additional tests. A mediation analysis indicated that the effects of warmth and competence were modulated by the extent to which participants cognitively (de)valued diagnostic information.
abstract.textZh: 如果醫生表現出高熱情和高能力，參與者對嚴重疾病的可能性評分顯著降低。進一步的結果表明，高熱情和能力也導致其他結果的改善，例如尋求另一位醫生的意見或額外測試的慾望降低。調解分析表明，溫暖和能力的影響受到參與者認知（去）價值診斷信息的程度的調節。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: For patients, diagnostic information does not speak for itself; the doctor's behavior critically determines how they integrate such information. Showing high warmth and competence can help patients put trust in them and update their illness beliefs accordingly.
abstract.textZh: 對於患者來說，診斷資訊並不能說明一切；醫生的行為關鍵決定了他們如何整合這些資訊。展現高度的熱情和能力可以幫助患者信任他們，並相應地更新他們的疾病信念。

articles.title: Interventions to Improve Outpatient Follow-up for Hospitalized Patients With Alcohol Use Disorder : A Systematic Review
articles.authors: Bernstein EY, Hills-Dunlap K, Challapalli A, Bero L, Calcaterra SL, Edelman EJ, Kruse GR, Harnke B, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Hospitalizations for alcohol use disorder (AUD) are common and morbid. Outpatient follow-up after discharge is critical for reducing alcohol use and subsequent readmissions, but effective interventions to support this transition are unknown.
abstract.textZh: 因酒精使用障礙（ AUD ）住院治療是常見且病態的。出院後的門診追蹤對於減少酒精使用和隨後的再入院至關重要，但支持這種過渡的有效幹預措施尚不清楚。

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: To summarize evidence on the effectiveness of hospital-based interventions to improve outpatient follow-up for AUD.
abstract.textZh: 總結有關以醫院為基礎的幹預措施有效性的證據，以改善AUD的門診隨訪。

abstract.label: DATA SOURCES
abstract.text: Ovid MEDLINE, EMBASE, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, PsycInfo, and CINAHL (January 2000 to February 2025).
abstract.textZh: Ovid MEDLINE、EMBASE、Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials、PsycInfo和CINAHL （ 2000年1月至2025年2月）。

abstract.label: STUDY SELECTION
abstract.text: Two authors independently reviewed abstracts and full-text articles to identify hospital-based trials and cohort studies that evaluated interventions to improve outpatient AUD follow-up versus usual care or an active comparator.
abstract.textZh: 兩位作者獨立審查了摘要和全文文章，以確定以醫院為基礎的試驗和隊列研究，這些試驗和研究評估介入措施，以改善門診AUD隨訪與常規護理或活躍對照者。

abstract.label: DATA EXTRACTION
abstract.text: Study data were extracted by 2 authors using a standardized template. Risk of bias and certainty of evidence were assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias Tool, Newcastle-Ottawa Scale, and GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation).
abstract.textZh: 研究資料由2位作者使用標準化範本提取。使用Cochrane Risk of Bias Tool、Newcastle-Ottawa Scale和GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation)評估偏誤風險和證據的確定性。

abstract.label: DATA SYNTHESIS
abstract.text: Seventeen studies of 21 interventions (12 randomized clinical trials [RCTs] [n = 1917], 3 nonrandomized trials [n = 459], and 2 cohort studies [n = 9974]) were included. Interventions were heterogeneous, and most (85%) included several components: behavioral (76%), care coordination (76%), medication management (14%), and social support (33%). Eight interventions (38%) reported improved linkage to outpatient follow-up. Effective interventions generally combined behavioral and care coordination with AUD medications or social support. Effect sizes across RCTs ranged from an 8% absolute decrease to a 30% absolute increase in outpatient follow-up. The certainty of evidence was low due to the high risk of bias and imprecision of results.
abstract.textZh: 納入了21項幹預措施的17項研究（ 12項隨機臨牀試驗[RCT] [n = 1917]、3項非隨機試驗[n = 459]和2項隊列研究[n = 9974] ）。介入是異質的，大多數（ 85 ％ ）包括幾個組成部分：行為（ 76 ％ ）、護理協調（ 76 ％ ）、藥物管理（ 14 ％ ）和社會支持（ 33 ％ ）。八項幹預措施（ 38 ％ ）報告與門診隨訪的聯繫有所改善。有效的幹預措施通常將行為和護理協調與澳元藥物或社會支持結合起來。RCT的效果大小從門診隨訪的8%絕對減少到30%絕對增加不等。由於偏見和結果不準確的風險很高，證據的確定性很低。

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Only English-language publications were included.
abstract.textZh: 只包括英文出版物。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Few intervention studies of low certainty improved posthospitalization follow-up for patients with AUD. Given the substantial morbidity associated with untreated AUD, high-quality RCTs testing various components of interventions are needed.
abstract.textZh: 很少有低確定性的幹預研究改善了AUD患者的住院後隨訪。鑑於與未治療的澳元相關的大量發病率，需要高質量的RCT來測試幹預措施的各個組成部分。

abstract.text: None. (PROSPERO: CRD42025636943).
abstract.textZh: 無。（ PROSPERO ： CRD42025636943 ）。

articles.title: Association Between Blood Hemoglobin Concentration and Mortality by Age and Sex : A Prospective Cohort Study
articles.authors: Ahmad M, Cleland JGF, Maffia P, Strawbridge RJ, Sattar N, Pell JP, Liu Q, Friday JM, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The 1959 World Health Organization (WHO) definition of anemia is widely used, but its relationship with mortality in the general adult population is uncertain.
abstract.textZh: 1959年世界衛生組織（ WHO ）對貧血的定義被廣泛使用，但其與一般成年人羣死亡率的關係尚不確定。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate associations between baseline hemoglobin concentration and long-term mortality by age and sex.
abstract.textZh: 按年齡和性別評估基線血紅蛋白濃度與長期死亡率之間的關聯。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Prospective cohort study.
abstract.textZh: 前瞻性隊列研究。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Population-based cohort in the United Kingdom.
abstract.textZh: 英國的人口基礎羣組。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: 502 188 adults (median age, 58 years; 54.4% women) recruited from 2006 to 2010; hemoglobin concentration was measured in 477 876 (95.2%). Analyses were stratified by sex and age (<60 vs. ≥60 years). Median follow-up was 13.6 years.
abstract.textZh: 從2006年至2010年招募了502 188名成人（中位年齡， 58歲； 54.4%婦女） ；在477 876 （ 95.2% ）中測量了血紅蛋白濃度。分析按性別和年齡分層（ < 60 vs. ≥ 60歲）。中位隨訪時間為13.6年。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Hemoglobin concentration categorized relative to WHO sex-specific thresholds (men, <13.0 g/dL; women, <12.0 g/dL). Outcomes were all-cause, cardiovascular, and cancer mortality.
abstract.textZh: 血紅蛋白濃度相對於WHO性別特異性閾值分類（男性， < 13.0 g/dL ；女性， < 12.0 g/dL ）。結果為全因、心血管和癌症死亡率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: All-cause mortality showed a U-shaped association with hemoglobin concentration, with lowest risk 1 to 3 g/dL above the WHO threshold. In the primary adjusted model, the 10-year standardized cumulative incidence (SCI) was 4.5% in the reference group versus 12.5% among participants more than 2 g/dL below the threshold (absolute risk difference [ARD], +8.1 percentage points; 95% CI, 6.7 to 9.4 percentage points); over the entire follow-up, the adjusted hazard ratio (HR) was 2.87 (CI, 2.54 to 3.25). Among those 0 to 1 g/dL above the threshold, the 10-year SCI was 5.3% (ARD, +0.8 percentage points; CI, 0.7 to 1.0 percentage points) and the adjusted HR was 1.18 (CI, 1.15 to 1.21). Associations were less consistent in women younger than 60 years. Patterns for cardiovascular and cancer mortality were similar at low and borderline concentrations but attenuated at higher concentrations.
abstract.textZh: 全因死亡率與血紅蛋白濃度呈U形關聯，最低風險高於WHO閾值1至3 g/dL。在主要調整模型中，參照組的10年標準化累積發生率(SCI)為4.5% ，大於閾值2 g/dL的參與者為12.5% (絕對風險差[ARD] ， +8.1個百分點； 95% CI ， 6.7至9.4個百分點) ；在整個隨訪期間，調整後風險比(HR)為2.87 (CI ， 2.54至3.25)。在高於閾值的0至1 g/dL中， 10年SCI為5.3% （ ARD ， +0.8個百分點； CI ， 0.7至1.0個百分點） ，調整後的HR為1.18 （ CI ， 1.15至1.21 ）。在60歲以下的女性中，相關性不太一致。心血管和癌症死亡率的模式在低濃度和邊緣濃度下相似，但在較高濃度下減弱。

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Single baseline hemoglobin concentration measurement; predominantly White population.
abstract.textZh: 單一基線期血紅蛋白濃度測量；主要是白人族羣。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Mortality was lowest at hemoglobin concentrations 1 to 3 g/dL above current WHO thresholds, with higher mortality below and above this range. These hypothesis-generating findings should not define new thresholds but may inform clinical interpretation and evaluation of borderline hemoglobin concentration values.
abstract.textZh: 當血紅蛋白濃度高於目前的WHO閾值1至3 g/dL時，死亡率最低，低於和高於此範圍的死亡率更高。這些假設產生的結果不應定義新的閾值，但可以為臨牀解釋和邊緣血紅蛋白濃度值的評估提供信息。

abstract.text: None.
abstract.textZh: 無。

articles.title: Recommended point-of-care tests in out-of-hours primary care: a modified Delphi study
articles.authors: Redek L, Brettell R, Payne R, Huibers L, Homar V

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Point-of-care tests (POCTs) are increasingly used to enhance diagnostic accuracy and facilitate rapid clinical decision making in settings with limited laboratory access. However, there is currently no consensus on which POCTs should be routinely available in out-of-hours (OOH) primary care services.
abstract.textZh: 即時檢測（ POCT ）越來越多地用於提高診斷準確性，並在實驗室訪問受限的環境中促進快速臨牀決策。然而，目前尚未就非工作時間（ OOH ）初級保健服務中應定期提供哪些POCT達成共識。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To establish expert consensus on which POCTs should be considered essential or optional in European OOH primary care services.
abstract.textZh: 在歐洲OOH初級保健服務中，應將哪些POCT視為必要或可選的專家共識。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A modified Delphi consensus study involving an international panel of experts from 20 European countries, representing diverse clinical and academic backgrounds in OOH primary care.
abstract.textZh: 一項經過修改的Delphi共識研究，涉及來自20個歐洲國家的國際專家小組，代表OOH初級保健的不同臨牀和學術背景。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: A three-round Delphi process was conducted. Round one assessed current POCT availability via questionnaire. In round two, panellists rated 28 POCTs as essential, optional, or unnecessary. In round three, results were discussed in a structured in-person workshop, followed by anonymous re-voting. Consensus was predefined as ≥66.6% agreement.
abstract.textZh: 進行了三輪德爾斐過程。第一輪通過問卷評估當前POCT的可用性。在第二輪中，專題小組成員將28個POCT評為必要、可選或不必要。在第三輪中，在結構化的現場研討會中討論了結果，然後進行了匿名重新投票。共識預定義為大於或等於66.6%。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Six POCTs achieved consensus as essential: blood glucose, urine dipstick, C-reactive protein, pregnancy testing, electrocardiography, and haemoglobin measurement. Twelve tests were classified as optional, and 10 were deemed unnecessary. Key concerns included inappropriate use, variability in clinician confidence, and patient-driven demand.
abstract.textZh: 六個POCT達成了共識：血糖、尿液試紙、C反應蛋白、妊娠測試、心電圖和血紅蛋白測量。12個測試被歸類為可選， 10個被認為是不必要的。關鍵問題包括不當使用、臨牀醫師信心的變異性以及患者驅動的需求。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: This study provides, to the authors' knowledge, the first European consensus on POCT prioritisation in OOH primary care. Implementation of essential POCTs, supported by training and governance, may improve diagnostic efficiency, while optional tests should be tailored to local service needs.
abstract.textZh: 據作者所知，這項研究提供了歐洲對OOH初級保健中POCT優先順序的第一個共識。在培訓和治理的支持下實施必要的POCT可以提高診斷效率，而可選測試應根據當地服務需求量身定制。

articles.authors: Harding C, Agarwal R, Bates J, Bray A, Milosevic S, Thomas-Jones E, Drinnan M, Drake M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Recent research has concluded that primary care assessment and management of lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) requires practical resources.
abstract.textZh: 最近的研究得出結論，初級保健評估和下尿路症狀（ LUTS ）的管理需要實用的資源。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To develop and independently validate risk-prediction models for three common urological conditions based on a combination of simple, minimally invasive index tests in men with LUTS presenting to primary care.
abstract.textZh: 基於對接受初級保健的LUTS男性進行簡單的微創指數測試的組合，開發並獨立驗證三種常見泌尿系統疾病的風險預測模型。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A prospective, multicentre, diagnostic accuracy study with independent development and validation cohorts set in 67 general practices in England and Wales.
abstract.textZh: 一項前瞻性、多中心、診斷準確性研究，在英格蘭和威爾斯的67個一般實踐中設置了獨立的開發和驗證隊列。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: A total of 601 men presenting to primary care with LUTS, 350 in the development cohort and 251 in the validation cohort, underwent index tests - validated symptom assessment, bladder diary, physical examination, serum prostate specific antigen, uroflowmetry, and post-void residual volume estimation. Invasive urodynamic studies provided a diagnostic reference standard. Risk-prediction models for urodynamic diagnoses were developed and then validated in independent cohorts. Discriminative and calibration performance of the risk-prediction models for diagnosing bladder outlet obstruction (BOO), detrusor underactivity (DU), and detrusor overactivity (DO) using the c-index, calibration slope and plot, and sensitivity and specificity of the models was undertaken.
abstract.textZh: 共有601名接受LUTS初級保健的男性， 350名在發展隊列中， 251名在驗證隊列中，接受了指數測試-驗證症狀評估、膀胱日記、體格檢查、血清前列腺特異性抗原、尿流量測定和排尿後剩餘體積估計。侵入性尿動力學研究提供了診斷參考標準。開發了尿動力學診斷的風險預測模型，然後在獨立隊列中進行驗證。使用c指數、校準斜率和繪圖來診斷膀胱出口阻塞（ BOO ）、逼尿肌活動不足（ DU ）和逼尿肌活動過度（ DO ）的風險預測模型的判別和校準性能，以及模型的靈敏度和特異性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The BOO model from the development cohort demonstrated good discriminative performance (optimism-corrected c-index of 0.80). The models derived from the development cohort for DU and DO demonstrated moderate discriminative ability (optimism-corrected c-indices of 0.64 and 0.67, respectively). Similar estimates of c-index were observed for each model within the independent validation cohort (BOO, 0.82; DU, 0.63; and DO, 0.62).

abstract.text: Using a combination of simple, non-invasive index tests can accurately predict common urological diagnoses in men with LUTS, potentially facilitating earlier initiation of evidence-based treatments and improved management in primary care.

articles.authors: Glogowska M, Moore M, Hay AD, Butler C, Hayward G

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Many women experience recurrent urinary tract infections (rUTIs) yet their significance for the women affected is poorly described and understood.
abstract.textZh: 許多婦女經歷復發性尿路感染（ rUTI ） ，但它們對受影響婦女的意義描述和理解不佳。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore women's experiences of rUTIs and the impact on their lives.

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A qualitative study embedded in a randomised controlled trial (RCT) of D-mannose with women with clinically defined rUTIs in England and Wales.

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: We conducted semi-structured telephone interviews with 32 women who participated in the RCT. Interviews were audio-recorded and transcribed verbatim. Data were analysed thematically.
abstract.textZh: 我們對參與RCT的32名女性進行了半結構化電話訪談。採訪是錄音和逐字記錄的。數據按主題進行分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Women reported how the experience of rUTIs was burdensome with distressing and debilitating physical symptoms and wider disruptive effects. Women expressed how rUTIs had an impact on different stages of their lives and we identified two types of impact. Internalised impact included the women's emotional response to rUTIs, dread of a recurrence, and maintaining readiness to manage it. Externalised impact encompassed actions in response to rUTIs, including remaining extremely vigilant about recurrences and seeking help as soon as a recurrence was suspected, and the challenges they faced. The women explained how the responses of healthcare professionals (HCPs) when they sought care affected their help-seeking and their self-esteem, and could leave them with a sense of helplessness.
abstract.textZh: 婦女報告說， rUTI的經驗如何因令人痛苦和虛弱的身體症狀以及更廣泛的破壞性影響而成為負擔。女性表達了rUTI如何影響其生活的不同階段，我們確定了兩種類型的影響。內在影響包括婦女對rUTI的情緒反應、對復發的恐懼以及保持管理它的準備。外部化影響包括應對rUTI的行動，包括對復發保持高度警惕，一旦懷疑復發就尋求幫助，以及他們面臨的挑戰。這些婦女解釋了醫療保健專業人員（ HCP ）在尋求護理時的反應如何影響他們尋求幫助和自尊，並可能使他們感到無助。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Experience of rUTIs has taught women to be vigilant and proactive about the condition but this was not always matched with understanding and validation on the part of HCPs. When women experiencing rUTIs seek care, clinicians could usefully consider the patient's broader experience of rUTIs, including internalised and externalised impacts.
abstract.textZh: RUTI的經驗教導女性對病情保持警惕和積極主動，但這並不總是與HCP的理解和驗證相匹配。當經歷rUTI的女性尋求護理時，臨牀醫生可以有益地考慮患者對rUTI的更廣泛經驗，包括內在和外在影響。

abstract.text: Background High-quality primary care can improve multimorbidity management but little evidence is available to understand its impact on secondary care use over time. Aim To assess the concurrent and lagged associations between quality of primary care and planned and unplanned secondary care use, examining the modifying role of frailty. Design and Setting A retrospective cohort study included 468,172 patients with multimorbidity in England from the Discover research platform (April 2022-March 2024). Method We used principal component analysis to combine a set of quality indicators (QIs) and assessed the impacts of QIs on both planned and unplanned care using regression models. Results Generally, patients with higher QI attainment also had higher likelihood of outpatient visits, emergency admissions and ED visits. There was a lower lagged odds of elective hospital admissions in the following 12 months among those with higher attainment of multimorbidity-specific QIs. In the complex multimorbidity cohort (≥3 conditions), multimorbidity-specific QIs were longitudinally associated with lower odds of elective admissions and outpatient visits, while generic QIs were related to lower odds of outpatient non-attendance. Conclusion Attainment of generic and multimorbidity QIs was generally associated with slightly increased planned and unplanned care. However, patients for whom we identified higher attainment of multimorbidity-specific QIs had lower odds of elective admissions and outpatient visits, especially for those with complex multimorbidity. Our research suggests that the quality of primary care may influence patients' use of secondary care, with the potential to improve care for people with multimorbidity and warrant further investigation into management strategies.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Maternal folic acid prevents neural tube defects, but associations of parental folate and vitamin B12 with birth defects remain unclear.

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Prospective cohort study.
abstract.textZh: 前瞻性隊列研究。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Shanghai Preconception Cohort, China.
abstract.textZh: 中國上海Preconception Cohort。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: 3032 couples (73 birth defect cases) with biomarkers sampled within 4 months before conception, and 17 765 women (327 birth defect cases) sampled at 4 months' gestation or earlier.
abstract.textZh: 3032對夫婦（ 73例出生缺陷病例）在懷孕前4個月內取樣， 17 765名婦女（ 327例出生缺陷病例）在懷孕4個月或更早時取樣。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Standardized predicted prevalences of birth defects ascertained among live births, stillbirths, and abortions due to fetal abnormalities were estimated using weighted logistic regression.
abstract.textZh: 使用加權邏輯迴歸估計活產、死產和胎兒異常墮胎之間確定的出生缺陷的標準化預測患病率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Higher preconception parental levels of vitamin B12 were associated with lower predicted prevalences of birth defects in dose-response analyses. abstract.text: Suicide is a major public health concern, and general practice is often a recent point of contact before death. Design and setting Explanatory sequential mixed‑methods study of 157 consecutive deaths by suicide recorded by coroners (2018-19) across five English local authorities. Method Demographic, clinical, and social data were extracted from coroners' records and summarised descriptively. Results Of 157 individuals: 79% were male; 65% lived in the most deprived IMD quintile; 85% had a diagnosed mental health condition; 62% had a long‑term physical illness; 41% had a previous suicide attempt. Common stressors were relationship breakdown (37.2%), housing instability (22.1%), and work pressures (18.2%). abstract.text: Learning disability registers in UK primary care support proactive care, but under-identification remains substantial. The 2019 NHS Long Term Plan introduced targets to increase enrolment.

abstract.text: Young people aged 14-24 years who had been registered ≥6 months were included. Annual rates of new registration per 10 000 person-years at risk (PYAR) and recorded prevalence were calculated, stratified by age, sex, region, and year.

abstract.text: Secondary analysis of publicly available general practice data.
