abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: NHS England data relating to the learning disabilities annual health check scheme from January 2022 to November 2025 were compiled and analysed.
abstract.textZh: 我們彙編並分析了英國國民保健署（ NHS ）在2022年1月至2025年11月期間與學習障礙年度健康檢查計劃相關的數據。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The number of 14-17-year-olds and adults on learning disability registers increased during this period by 30.49% and 14.53%, respectively. The most recent estimates indicate that around 0.588% (n = 374 763/63 766 671) of patients are on learning disability registers, with approximately 0.526% (n = 355 102/63 654 156) aged ≥14 years and eligible for annual health checks. The uptake of annual health checks increased slightly from 68.08% (n = 15 940/23 414) to 71.58% (n = 19 217/26 846) among 14-17-year-olds, and from 79.07% (n = 226 701/286 714) to 80.71% (n = 248 449/307 827) among adults. Uptake was lowest in the South West and East of England, and highest in London, but was similar across deciles of patient deprivation and practice size.
abstract.textZh: 在此期間，學習障礙登記冊上的14-17歲和成人人數分別增加了30.49%和14.53%。最近的估計表明，約有0.588 ％ （ n = 374 763/63 766 671 ）的患者在學習障礙登記冊上，約有0.526 ％ （ n = 355 102/63 654 156 ）年齡≥ 14歲，有資格進行年度健康檢查。14-17歲兒童接受年度健康檢查的比例從68.08% （ n = 15 940/23 414 ）略微增加到71.58% （ n = 19 217/26 846 ） ，成年人從79.07% （ n = 226 701/286 714 ）增加到80.71% （ n = 248 449/307 827 ）。攝取量在英格蘭西南部和東部最低，在倫敦最高，但在患者剝奪和實踐規模方面相似。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Ascertainment of people with a learning disability by primary care services appears to be improving but remains between one-third and one-quarter of prevalence estimates. The uptake of annual health checks among 14-17-year-olds continues to lag behind that of adults.
abstract.textZh: 初級護理服務對學習障礙人士的確定似乎正在改善，但仍在估計患病率的三分之一至四分之一之間。14-17歲的年度健康檢查率繼續落後於成年人。

articles.titleZh: 學習障礙年度健康檢查採用方面的差異：初級保健數據的次要分析

articles.title: Relationships of actual and expected levels of income with GP job satisfaction: repeated cross-sectional study
articles.authors: Walker B, Anderson M, Ganepola R, Hutchinson J, Gibson J, Urwin S, Checkland K, Sutton M

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Income is known to be a key driver of job satisfaction, especially when compared with expected income. The pertinence of this for GPs is not fully understood.
abstract.textZh: 眾所周知，收入是工作滿意度的關鍵驅動因素，尤其是與預期收入相比。這與全科醫生的相關性尚不完全清楚。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To examine whether GP job satisfaction and intentions to quit are affected by actual and expected levels of income.
abstract.textZh: 檢查全科醫生的工作滿意度和辭職意圖是否受到實際和預期收入水平的影響。

abstract.label: DESIGN & SETTING
abstract.text: Repeated cross-sectional study involving GPs in England. The authors analysed responses to four waves of the GP Worklife Survey (a survey of GPs in England), between 2015 and 2021.
abstract.textZh: 在英格蘭重複進行涉及全科醫生的橫斷面研究。作者分析了2015年至2021年間對四波全科醫生工作生活調查（英格蘭全科醫生調查）的回應。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Linear regression models were used to examine the associations of actual income with 10 domains of job satisfaction and three aspects of intentions to quit, adjusted for potential confounders; responders' self-reported expected incomes were then added to these models. These analyses were repeated, stratifying by contract status and age.
abstract.textZh: 使用線性迴歸模型來檢查實際收入與10個工作滿意度領域和三個辭職意圖方面的關聯，並針對潛在的混雜因素進行調整；然後將回應者自我報告的預期收入添加到這些模型中。重複這些分析，按合約狀態和年齡分層。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Higher actual income had a statistically significant association with increased satisfaction across most job satisfaction domains except for 'Amount of variety in your job', 'Your colleagues and fellow workers', and 'Physical working conditions'. There was little evidence of a relationship between actual income and intentions to quit. Higher expected income, conditional on actual income, had a statistically significant association with reduced job satisfaction across all domains and increased intentions to quit. The relationship between expected income and intentions to work abroad in the next 5 years was stronger for GPs aged <40 years, and the relationship between actual income and job satisfaction was stronger for GP partners and for GPs aged >50 years.
abstract.textZh: 除了「您工作的多樣性」、「您的同事和同事」和「實際工作條件」之外，實際收入越高，大多數工作滿意度領域的滿意度就越高。實際收入與辭職意圖之間的關係幾乎沒有證據。以實際收入為條件的較高預期收入與所有領域的工作滿意度降低和辭職意向增加有著統計學上的顯著關聯。對於年齡< 40歲的全科醫生，未來5年預期收入與出國工作意願之間的關係更強，而對於全科醫生合作夥伴和年齡> 50歲的全科醫生，實際收入與工作滿意度之間的關係更強。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Higher incomes were associated with higher job satisfaction, but lower than expected levels of income were important sources of dissatisfaction and intentions to quit.
abstract.textZh: 較高的收入與較高的工作滿意度有關，但低於預期的收入水平是不滿意和辭職意圖的重要來源。

articles.titleZh: 實際和預期收入水平與GP工作滿意度的關係：重複橫斷面研究

articles.title: Investigating the conditions in which women GPs thrive in general practice: a realist review
articles.authors: Abrams R, Williams V, Park S, Golder S, Goyal A, Whiley L, Jefferson L

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Women GPs experience higher rates of burnout, anxiety, depression, and slower career progression than men GPs. Women GPs are sought out by patients for specific conditions, which may increase consultation length. This can be a source of job satisfaction for some. However, it can also contribute to additional exhaustion and affects career progression, meaning women GPs are at higher risk of leaving the profession. There is an urgent need to identify solutions to retain and support them.
abstract.textZh: 與男性全科醫生相比，女性全科醫生的職業倦怠、焦慮、抑鬱和職業發展緩慢率更高。患者會針對特定情況尋求女性全科醫生，這可能會增加會診時間。對某些人來說，這可能是工作滿意度的來源。然而，它也可能導致額外的疲憊並影響職業發展，這意味著女性全科醫生離開職業的風險更高。迫切需要確定留住和支持他們的解決方案。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: This review brings together a wide range of evidence to identify the conditions in which women GPs can thrive, to better support them at work.
abstract.textZh: 這項審查匯集了廣泛的證據，以確定女性全科醫生可以茁壯成長的條件，以便在工作中更好地支持她們。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: An international realist review of academic and grey literature was conducted across eight databases and Google Scholar.
abstract.textZh: 在八個資料庫和Google學術搜尋中，對學術文獻和灰色文獻進行了國際現實主義審查。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Following a realist approach, supported by stakeholder and patient involvement, a range of published documents were analysed using a realist logic to identify how, why, for whom, and in what circumstances women GPs thrive at work.
abstract.textZh: 在利益相關者和患者參與的支持下，遵循現實主義的方法，使用現實主義邏輯分析了一系列已發佈的文件，以確定女性全科醫生如何、為什麼、為誰以及在什麼情況下在工作中茁壯成長。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 72 documents are included in this review. Sixteen configurations describe the conditions in which women GPs can thrive. Results cover the following three concepts: patient-facing work; navigating competing roles; and sustainable careers, leadership, and success. However, literature also places heavy reliance on encouraging women GPs to 'fix' their own circumstances.
abstract.textZh: 本次審核共包含72份文件。十六種配置描述了女性全科醫生可以茁壯成長的條件。結果涵蓋以下三個概念：面向患者的工作；導航相互競爭的角色；以及可持續的職業生涯、領導力和成功。然而，文獻也嚴重依賴鼓勵女性全科醫生「修復」自己的情況。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: This review provides evidence-based recommendations that may be of interest to those responsible for organisational culture within general practices, including (but not limited to) GP partners, and women GPs, who can utilise the recommendations to influence change.
abstract.textZh: 本審查提供以證據為基礎的建議，這些建議可能對一般實踐中負責組織文化的人員感興趣，包括（但不限於）全科醫生合作夥伴和女性全科醫生，他們可以利用這些建議來影響變革。

articles.titleZh: 調查女性全科醫生在一般診所中茁壯成長的條件：現實主義審查

articles.title: Tuberculosis
articles.authors: Pillay T, Kon OM, Lalvani A

abstract.text: Tuberculosis (TB) is the leading cause of infection-related mortality in the world, and cases in the United States are increasing. Prompt diagnosis, isolation, and treatment improve patient outcomes and reduce onward transmission. Screening of contacts and high-risk persons for asymptomatic TB infection and treatment of those testing positive reduces progression to disease. TB disease should be suspected in persons with compatible symptoms, risk factors, and consistent imaging. Microbiological confirmation requires an acid-fast smear, nucleic acid amplification test, and culture. Treatment, guided by drug sensitivity testing, requires multiple antibiotics given for 4 to 9 months and monitoring for drug toxicity and clinical response.
abstract.textZh: 結核病（ TB ）是全球感染相關死亡的主要原因，美國的病例正在增加。及時診斷、隔離和治療可改善患者結果並減少繼續傳播。篩選接觸者和無症狀結核病感染的高風險人羣，並治療那些檢測呈陽性的人，可減少疾病進展。在症狀、風險因素和一致的影像學檢查中，應懷疑患者患有結核病。微生物確認需要抗酸塗片、核酸擴增測試和培養。在藥物敏感性測試的指導下，治療需要服用多種抗生素4至9個月，並監測藥物毒性和臨牀反應。

articles.title: Fewer Abortions in States with More Family Physicians
articles.authors: Weidner A

abstract.label: PURPOSE
abstract.text: Primary care physicians providing abortion services-particularly family physicians (FPs), who provide the majority of care in rural and underserved settings-could enhance access to abortion and family planning services. The primary objective of this study was to evaluate the association between the rate of abortions and availability of FPs by state.
abstract.textZh: 提供墮胎服務的初級保健醫生，尤其是在農村和服務不足的環境中提供大部分護理的家庭醫生（ FP ） ，可以增加獲得墮胎和計劃生育服務的機會。本研究的主要目的是評估各州墮胎率與FP可用性之間的關聯。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: This was an exploratory ecological study of secondary data compiled from several state sources in the United States. The primary dependent variable was abortion rate, and the primary independent variable was FPs per population, with internists and obstetrician/gynecologists (ob/gyns) analyzed as comparison. Other variables included pregnancies and abortion clinics per population; percent of a state's population in rural areas; and state abortion law. Each comparison was analyzed with a two-tailed Pearson's correlation test followed by multivariate linear regression.
abstract.textZh: 這是一項探索性生態研究，研究來自美國多個州的二手數據。主要因變量是流產率，主要自變量是每個族羣的FP ，並分析內科醫生和產科醫生/婦科醫生(ob/gyns)作為比較。其他變數包括每個人口的懷孕和墮胎診所；鄉村地區佔州人口的百分比；以及州墮胎法。每個比較均使用雙尾Pearson相關性檢驗進行分析，然後進行多元線性回歸。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The number of physicians per 100,000 population was significant in all three models when controlling for the other variables, but in different directions: more internists and more ob/gyns were associated with greater abortion rates (B = .253 [.037], P < .001 and B = .807 [.174], P < .001), while more FPs were associated with lower abortion rates (B = -.212 [.064], P = .002). Each model was reliably predictive of abortion rates and explained most of the variance in abortion rates by state.
abstract.textZh: 在控制其他變量時，每10萬人口中醫師的數量在所有三個模型中都是顯著的，但在不同的方向上：更多內科醫師和更多的婦產科醫師與更高的墮胎率相關（ B = .253 [.037] ， P < .001和B = .807 [.174] ， P < .001 ） ，而更多的FP與更低的墮胎率相關（ B = -.212 [.064] ， P = .002 ）。每個模型都能可靠地預測墮胎率，並解釋各州墮胎率的大部分差異。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Fewer abortions in states with more FPs and more in states with ob/gyns and internists may suggest an access issue in the states with more FPs. FPs providing abortion care could be part of a solution for improving patient access to that care, particularly in rural areas.
abstract.textZh: 在擁有較多FP的州，墮胎數量較少，而在擁有婦產科醫生和內科醫生的州，墮胎數量較多，這可能表明，在擁有較多FP的州，墮胎數量存在問題。提供墮胎護理的FP可以成為改善患者獲得該護理的解決方案的一部分，特別是在農村地區。

articles.title: Comprehensive Primary Care Team Model: Early Insights on Implementation from Care Teams in Family Medicine
articles.authors: Sanchez K, Ramm J, Sewell S, Vazquez C, Reece S

abstract.text: Family medicine faces critical challenges including workforce shortages, limited patient access, and the need for sustainable care models. We implemented a Comprehensive Primary Care Team (CPCT) model pairing physicians with three to four advanced practice clinicians (APCs) in four community-based clinics serving rural Central Texas. This special communication provides insights into early implementation of this model (about 12 months post-implementation). We conducted informal qualitative interviews to understand clinician perspectives on early implementation. This included site visits with the four clinics piloting the CPCT model (n = 19). Interviewees included physicians and APCs. Interviews focused on daily workflows, scheduling, interprofessional communication, patient access, panel-size management, collaborative practices, and perceived barriers. We also conducted an analysis of third next available appointment using administrative data to get a snapshot of our goal to increase access. This analysis compares one CPCT model clinic with a solo-practice clinic. Insights from these informal interviews centered on 4 themes: (1) Teamwork and Collaboration, (2) Access and Scheduling, (3) Panel-Size Management, (4) Clinician Satisfaction. The third next available appointment analysis revealed substantially more appointment availability in the CPCT model clinic across multiple visit types. The CPCT model has potential to be a scalable innovation enabling family medicine practices to safely expand panel sizes, improve access to care, and operationalize physician-led population health management. Ongoing challenges include right-sizing teams, space limitations, and workflow optimization, but early insights support replication in primary care settings seeking to address access gaps and workforce constraints while maintaining quality of care.

articles.title: Preventive Care: Cornerstone or Constraint for Family Medicine? How Much Should We Prioritize Clinical Preventive Services?
articles.authors: Morris CG, Seehusen DA, Cole S

abstract.text: In August 2025, family physicians gathered for the Family Medicine Leaders Consortium to share perspectives on whether family physicians should continue to prioritize clinical preventive services amid rising patient complexity, documentation burdens, policy constraints, and post-pandemic challenges. This paper synthesizes competing perspectives and overarching commentary from the consortium meeting. One viewpoint argues that preventive care remains essential to family medicine's core values, patient expectations, and economic viability. The opposing viewpoint contends that preventive services are increasingly algorithmic, delegable, poorly reimbursed, and, while important, are no longer core to family medicine. Together, these perspectives illustrate the need for ongoing, future-focused discussions about family medicine's identity as a specialty.
abstract.textZh: 2025年8月，家庭醫生聚集在家庭醫學領袖聯盟（ Family Medicine Leaders Consortium ） ，就家庭醫生在患者複雜性、文件負擔、政策限制和疫情後挑戰日益增加的情況下，是否應繼續優先提供臨牀預防服務分享觀點。本文綜合了來自聯盟會議的競爭觀點和總體評論。一種觀點認為，預防性護理對於家庭醫學的核心價值、患者期望和經濟可行性仍然至關重要。相反的觀點認為，預防性服務越來越具有算法性，可委託性，報銷很少，雖然很重要，但已不再是家庭醫學的核心。這些觀點共同表明，關於家庭醫學作為專業的身份，需要持續進行以未來為中心的討論。

articles.title: The Impact of Race on Advanced Care Planning: Results of a Quality Improvement Project
articles.authors: Lear A, Arnold M, Bouhenni R, Mangira C, Adelman M, Baldie K, George E

abstract.label: INTRODUCTION
abstract.text: Research suggests racial disparities affect the likelihood that patients engage in advanced care planning (ACP). With this quality assurance initiative, we sought to determine whether racial disparities exist in ACP at our institution.
abstract.textZh: 研究表明，種族差異會影響患者參與高級護理計劃（ ACP ）的可能性。通過這項質量保證計劃，我們試圖確定我們機構的ACP中是否存在種族差異。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We performed a retrospective chart review of patients 65 years of age and older who were seen at our institution from January 1, 2021 through December 31, 2022. The primary objective was to determine whether racial disparities exist in ACP among these patients. ACP was identified if the electronic health record (EHR) indicated presence of an advance directive, healthcare power of attorney, and/or ACP discussion or visit with a clinician.
abstract.textZh: 我們對2021年1月1日至2022年12月31日期間在我們機構就診的65歲及以上患者進行了回顧性圖表回顧。主要目的是確定這些患者在ACP中是否存在種族差異。如果電子健康記錄（ EHR ）顯示存在預先指示、醫療保健授權書和/或ACP討論或臨牀醫生就診，則確定為ACP。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: In total, 22,372 patients were included. The median age was 74.1 (interquartile range [IQR] 69.4-80.5). White patients accounted for 87.4% of the total, 11.2% were Black, and 1.4% were another race. Females were 51.5%, 55.1% were married, and 88 % were insured by Medicare. Black patients and patients of other races were less likely than White patients to have an ACP (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] = 0.64; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.58-0.71; P < .0001 and aOR = 0.63; 95% CI, 0.48-0.82; P = .0007, respectively). Older patients and those with more chronic disease (elevated Charlson comorbidity index) were more likely to complete ACP (aOR = 1.48; 95% CI, 1.42-1.54; P < .0001 and aOR = 1.32; 95% CI, 1.30-1.35; P < .0001, respectively).
abstract.textZh: 共有22,372名患者被納入研究。中位數年齡為74.1 （四分位數範圍[IQR] 69.4-80.5 ）。白人患者佔總數的87.4% ， 11.2%是黑人， 1.4%是另一種族。女性佔51.5% ， 55.1%已婚， 88%由Medicare投保。與白人患者相比，黑人患者和其他種族患者患ACP的可能性較低（調整比值比[aOR] = 0.64 ； 95%置信區間[CI] ， 0.58-0.71 ； P < 0.0001和aOR = 0.63 ； 95% CI ， 0.48-0.82 ； P = 0.0007 ）。老年患者和慢性病患者（ Charlson合並症指數升高）更有可能完成ACP （ aOR = 1.48 ； 95% CI ， 1.42-1.54 ； P < 0.0001和aOR = 1.32 ； 95% CI ， 1.30-1.35 ； P < 0.0001 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Our findings show differences in rates of ACP completion by race at our institution, which is consistent with previous research. The next step in our quality initiative is to develop interventions to promote equitable opportunities for such planning.
abstract.textZh: 我們的研究結果顯示，我們機構按種族劃分的ACP完成率存在差異，這與先前的研究一致。我們質量計劃的下一步是制定幹預措施，以促進此類規劃的公平機會。

articles.titleZh: 種族對進階護理計劃的影響：質量改善項目的結果

articles.title: Impact of a Primary Care Value-Based Compensation Model
articles.authors: Ulin L, Rotenstein L, Gitomer R, Samal L, Bakshi S, Rachelefsky L, Lewis J, Sullivan EE

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Primary care is essential for achieving high quality population health; however, its future remains uncertain with pervasive provider burnout, compensation structures based on service volume, and systemic undervaluation relative to specialty care. Value-based payment models aim to improve health outcomes and reduce costs, yet their implementation in academic medical centers remains complex. This study examined primary care physicians' perceived impacts of changing to a value-based compensation model in a large academic medical center.
abstract.textZh: 初級保健對於實現高質量人羣健康至關重要；然而，由於醫療服務提供者普遍過勞、基於服務量的薪酬結構以及相對於專科醫療的系統性低估，初級保健的未來仍然不確定。以價值為基礎的付款模式旨在改善健康結果並降低成本，但它們在學術醫療中心的實施仍然複雜。這項研究檢查了初級保健醫生在大型學術醫療中心改用基於價值的補償模型的感知影響。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: A mixed methods study was conducted using semi-structured interviews with 17 primary care physicians across 12 practices affiliated with Brigham and Women's Hospital (BWH), an academic medical center in Boston, Massachusetts. Interview transcripts were analyzed using a hybrid deductive-inductive thematic approach. Quantitative data included changes in panel size, panel growth, the proportion of physicians meeting panel targets, and quality metrics for patients with chronic disease.
abstract.textZh: 使用半結構化訪談對馬薩諸塞州波士頓的學術醫療中心Brigham and Women's Hospital (BWH)的12家診所的17名初級保健醫生進行了混合方法研究。採用混合演繹誘導主題法分析面試成績單。定量數據包括面板尺寸、面板增長、醫生達到面板目標的比例以及慢性病患者的質量指標的變化。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Three years after implementing a value-based compensation model, the total number of covered lives in BWH's primary care department increased by 31,000, representing a growth rate of 6.8%-9% annually. Physicians identified three primary domains differentiating fee-for-service (FFS) and value-based compensation models: provider experience, access to care, and system-level factors. Reported advantages of the new model included recognition of inter-visit work and reduced productivity pressures. However, concerns emerged about limitations in patient access and persistent systemic challenges, including understaffing.
abstract.textZh: 實施以價值為基礎的補償模式三年後， BWH初級保健部門的涵蓋生命總數增加了31,000 ，年增長率為6.8% -9%。醫生確定了區分服務費（ FFS ）和基於價值的薪酬模型的三個主要領域：提供者體驗、獲得護理服務和系統級因素。據報導，新模式的優勢包括識別訪問間的工作和減少生產力壓力。然而，出現了對患者訪問限制和持續的系統性挑戰（包括人員不足）的擔憂。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: A value-based compensation model in academic primary care may enhance panel management and physician experience. However, long-term success depends on addressing systemic barriers and aligning clinical productivity expectations with value-based goals.
abstract.textZh: 基於價值的學術初級護理報酬模型可以增強面板管理和醫生經驗。然而，長期成功取決於解決系統性障礙，並使臨牀生產力預期與基於價值的目標保持一致。

articles.titleZh: 基於初級保健價值的補償模式的影響

articles.title: US Trends in Lacking a Personal Doctor, by Educational Attainment, 2016-2023
articles.authors: Burmeister JR, Rubino IJ

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Having a personal doctor is a cornerstone of primary care and is associated with improved preventive service use, chronic disease management, and patient satisfaction. Educational attainment is a key social determinant of health and access to care.
abstract.textZh: 擁有私人醫生是初級保健的基石，與改善預防服務使用、慢性病管理和患者滿意度有關。受教育程度是健康和獲得護理的關鍵社會決定因素。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We analyzed national trends in the percentage of US adults lacking a personal doctor from 2016 to 2023 using the State Health Compare tool (SHADAC) based on the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS). Adults were classified by educational attainment: less than high school, high school graduate, some college/associate's degree, and bachelor's degree or higher. The SHADAC "no personal doctor" measure is based on self-report: respondents answering "no" to the BRFSS question "Do you have one person you think of as your personal doctor or health care provider?" were considered to lack a personal doctor. Only descriptive statistics were used; no inferential testing was performed.
abstract.textZh: 我們使用基於行為風險因素監測系統（ BRFSS ）的州健康比較工具（ SHADAC ）分析了2016年至2023年美國成年人缺乏私人醫生的百分比的國家趨勢。成人按教育程度分類：低於高中，高中畢業，一些大學/副學士學位和學士學位或更高。SHADAC的「無私人醫生」測量基於自我報告：對BRFSS問題「您認為有一個人是您的私人醫生或醫療保健提供者嗎？」回答「否」的受訪者被認為缺乏私人醫生。僅使用描述性統計資料；未執行推論測試。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Nationally, the share of adults without a personal doctor declined from 21.9% in 2016 to 17.1% in 2023 (absolute change -4.8 percentage points; relative change -21.8%). Reductions occurred across all education groups, but disparities persisted. In 2023, 30.8% of adults with less than a high school diploma reported lacking a personal doctor, compared with 9.7% among those with a bachelor's degree or higher-a gap of over 21 percentage points. Improvements were largest for college-educated adults (-36.0% relative change) and smallest for those without a high school diploma (-2.9%).
abstract.textZh: 在全國範圍內，沒有私人醫生的成年人比例從2016年的21.9%下降到2023年的17.1% （絕對變化-4.8個百分點；相對變化-21.8% ）。所有教育羣體都出現了減少，但差異仍然存在。2023年，高中文憑以下的成年人中有30.8%報告缺乏私人醫生，而學士學位或更高學歷的成年人中有9.7%報告缺乏私人醫生，差距超過21個百分點。受過大學教育的成年人的改善最大（相對變化為-36.0 ％ ） ，而沒有高中文憑的成年人的改善最小（ -2.9 ％ ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Despite overall improvement, large and persistent education-related disparities remain. Interventions such as care-navigation support, insurance literacy programs, and payment models that fund outreach may help address these gaps. The persistent 21-point gap highlights the ongoing challenge for equity in primary care access in the United States.
abstract.textZh: 儘管整體情況有所改善，但與教育相關的巨大而持久的差距仍然存在。照顧導航支援、保險素養計劃和資助外展工作的付款模式等幹預措施可能有助於彌補這些差距。持續的21分差距突顯了美國在初級保健服務公平性方面持續存在的挑戰。

articles.titleZh: 美國缺乏私人醫生的趨勢，按教育程度分列， 2016-2023年

articles.title: Hospital Utilization Among Users of Electronic Nicotine Delivery Systems (ENDS) Compared to Other Tobacco Users
articles.authors: Khanna N, Kwan CS, Klyushnenkova EN, Kernan C, Dark M, Melamed J, Deepak J

abstract.label: INTRODUCTION
abstract.text: Use of electronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) poses a significant and avoidable risk to respiratory health, yet its effect is not fully understood. This study examines the levels of hospital utilization among those who use ENDS and/or other tobacco and develop respiratory conditions.
abstract.textZh: 使用電子尼古丁輸送系統（ ENDS ）對呼吸健康構成重大且可避免的風險，但其影響尚未完全了解。本研究檢查使用ENDS和/或其他煙草並發展呼吸系統疾病的患者的醫院使用水平。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: 260,149 adult patients were screened for ENDS use between August 2020 and June 2022 at the University of Maryland Medical System. Multivariable nominal logistic regression modeling was used to assess associations between tobacco/nicotine use and emergency department (ED) or inpatient utilization due to respiratory conditions defined by admission or discharge ICD-10 J codes. Covariates included age, sex, race, Elixhauser comorbidity score, and history of COVID-19.
abstract.textZh: 在2020年8月至2022年6月期間，在馬裏蘭大學醫學系統篩選了260,149名成人患者。使用多變量名義邏輯回歸建模來評估由入院或出院ICD-10 J代碼定義的呼吸條件導致的煙草/尼古丁使用與急診科（ ED ）或住院患者使用之間的關聯。共變因素包括年齡、性別、種族、Elixhauser合併症評分和COVID-19病史。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among ENDS-only users, non-Hispanic White and Other-race patients had statistically significant increased healthcare utilization compared to never users (those who never use ENDS or tobacco). 18-44 year-old patients in these two race groups had 1.9-2.3 times higher odds of utilizing the ED compared to those who never used tobacco; and 65+ year-old non-Hispanic White patients had 2.4 times higher odds of inpatient admission compared to patients who never used tobacco. The odds of increased healthcare utilization among those who used both ENDS and other tobacco ranged from 1.4-2.4 and also varied by age and race.
abstract.textZh: 在僅ENDS用戶中，非西班牙裔白人和其他種族患者的醫療保健利用率比從未使用者（從未使用ENDS或煙草的患者）有統計學意義上的顯著增加。這兩個種族組中的18-44歲患者使用ED的機率比從未使用煙草的患者高1.9-2.3倍； 65歲以上的非西班牙裔白人患者的住院機率比從未使用煙草的患者高2.4倍。使用兩端煙草和其他煙草的人羣中，醫療保健利用率增加的機率範圍為1.4-2.4 ，並且也因年齡和種族而異。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: ENDS and tobacco use were associated with increased hospital utilization, including ED and inpatient, due to respiratory illnesses in an age- and race-dependent manner.
abstract.textZh: 由於年齡和種族相關的呼吸系統疾病，末端和煙草使用與醫院利用率的增加有關，包括急診和住院病人。

articles.titleZh: 與其他煙草使用者相比，電子尼古丁輸送系統（ ENDS ）使用者的醫院使用情況

articles.title: Large Language Model versus Clinician Written Summaries of Research Papers
articles.authors: Guthmann R, Martin R, Lee E, Boisselle C

abstract.label: INTRODUCTION
abstract.text: Clinicians require concise, accurate summaries of new research to inform practice. Patient-Oriented Evidence that Matters (POEMs), published in American Family Physician, are a benchmark for summarizing primary literature in family medicine, while large language models (LLMs) offer scalable summarization but require rigorous evaluation. The objective of this study was to evaluate the accuracy and quality of summaries generated by large language models compared with expert-authored POEMs.
abstract.textZh: 臨牀醫生需要簡潔、準確的新研究摘要來為實踐提供信息。《美國家庭醫生》(American Family Physician)發表的以患者為導向的重要證據(POEM)是總結家庭醫學主要文獻的基準，而大型語言模型(LLM)則提供可擴展的總結，但需要嚴格的評估。本研究的目的是評估大型語言模型與專家撰寫的POEM產生的摘要的準確性和質量。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this study, we compared LLM-generated summaries (Microsoft Copilot, GPT-4o class) with 24 recent matched POEMs using a standardized prompt. Two trained raters independently scored each summary with a 13-item tool (score range 0-13), cataloged errors, recorded word counts, and indicated preferences on a 5-point scale.
abstract.textZh: 在這項研究中，我們使用標準化提示將LLM生成的摘要（ Microsoft Copilot ， GPT-4o類別）與24個最近匹配的POEM進行了比較。兩位受過訓練的評分者使用13項工具（分數範圍為0-13 ）獨立評分每個摘要、編目錯誤、記錄的字數，並以5分制表示偏好。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: LLM summaries outperformed POEMs in total score (mean 12.1 vs 10.6; mean difference 1.5, 95% CI 1.1-2.0; P < 0.001), with similar lengths (328 vs 353 words; P = 0.23). Errors occurred in fewer LLM-DOCSs (2/24) than POEMs (9/24), with a mean error score difference of 20% (95% CI 7% -33%; P < 0.001). POEMs most often missed in the categories Contextual Background and Limitations; both approaches frequently missed in Clinical Applicability. Reviewer preference favored LLM-DOCS (mean 2.44 on a 1-5 scale; 95% CI 2.1-2.8).
abstract.textZh: LLM總結在總分上優於POEM （平均12.1對10.6 ；平均差異1.5 ， 95% CI 1.1-2.0 ； P < 0.001 ） ，長度相似（ 328對353字； P = 0.23 ）。LLM-DOCS （ 2/24 ）的錯誤比POEM （ 9/24 ）少，平均錯誤分數差異為20% （ 95% CI 7% -33% ； P < 0.001 ）。上下文背景和局限性類別中最常遺漏的POEM ；臨牀適用性中經常遺漏這兩種方法。評論者偏好LLM-DOCS （ 1-5分的平均值為2.44 ； 95% CI 2.1-2.8 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: An enterprise LLM, prompted in POEM style, produced accurate, low-error clinical summaries that matched or exceeded expert-edited POEMs and were generally preferred by reviewers, though further research is needed to assess broader applicability and impact. Findings support pragmatic LLM-assisted summarization and highlight the need for standardized evaluation tools and explicit prompts for clinical applicability.
abstract.textZh: 一個企業法學碩士，以詩歌風格提示，產生了準確、低誤差的臨牀摘要，與專家編輯的POEM相匹配或超過專家編輯的POEM ，並且通常是審稿人的首選，儘管還需要進一步的研究來評估更廣泛的適用性和影響。研究結果支持實用的LLM輔助總結，並強調需要標準化的評估工具和明確的臨牀適用性提示。

articles.titleZh: 大型語言模型與臨牀醫生撰寫的研究論文摘要

articles.title: The Impact of Biases for Early-Career Women in Medicine: "It's the Little Day-to-Day Microaggressions"
articles.authors: Byrd M, Filippi MK, Siddiqi A, Fleischer S, Bazemore A, Koempel A

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Women physicians face multiple systemic and social biases in the clinical setting that erode mental and physical well-being. Gender-based discrimination was reported by 76% of early-career women physicians, decreasing to 57% for mid-career, and 36% for late-career. While these trends suggest that these biases may diminish with career progression, they remain a persistent burden of women physician's careers. This article offers a unique contribution by centering early-career women family physicians, a group underrepresented in qualitative research on workplace bias. This article focuses on participants' microaggressive experiences in the clinical setting to better understand the biases they face.
abstract.textZh: 女性醫生在臨牀環境中面臨多種系統性和社會性偏見，這些偏見會侵蝕身心健康。76 ％的早期職業女性醫生報告了基於性別的歧視，職業生涯中期降至57 ％ ，職業生涯晚期降至36 ％。雖然這些趨勢表明，這些偏見可能會隨著職業發展而減少，但它們仍然是女性醫生職業生涯的長期負擔。本文以職場偏見定性研究中代表性不足的早期職業女性家庭醫生為中心，提供了獨特的貢獻。本文著重於參與者在臨牀環境中的微攻擊體驗，以更好地了解他們面臨的偏見。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: Via email we recruited 25 geographically and racially diverse early-career women physicians who responded to the 2021-2023 American Board of Family Medicine National Graduate Survey. A semi-structured interview guide was developed following a life-history approach to better understand the transitionary phase from residency to the practicing workforce. Interviews were transcribed verbatim, cleaned, and analyzed via Inductive Content Analysis in NVivo by qualitative researchers.
abstract.textZh: 透過電子郵件，我們招募了25位地理和種族多元化的早期職業女性醫生，她們回應了2021-2023年美國家庭醫學委員會全國研究生調查。根據生活史方法開發了半結構化面試指南，以更好地了解從住院醫生到實習勞動力的過渡階段。訪談由定性研究人員在NVivo中通過歸納內容分析逐字轉錄、清理和分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: We identified three main themes that emerged from the data. First, biased communications within the clinical setting exposed a pattern of gender bias. Second, patients invalidate physicians' positions based on appearance and perception. Third, women physicians described navigating the emotional and psychological labor of clinical and societal expectations.
abstract.textZh: 我們從數據中確定了三個主要主題。首先，臨牀環境中的偏見溝通暴露了性別偏見的模式。其次，患者根據外表和感知使醫生的立場無效。第三，女性醫生描述了導航臨牀和社會期望的情感和心理勞動。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: In the context of primary care, microaggressions demand direct and intentional intervention. Failing to address these experiences jeopardizes both equity and workforce sustainability. Leadership must be equipped to recognize, interrupt, and respond to microaggressions-not only to support individual clinicians but to strengthen organizational culture and the broader primary care mission. Interference reflects the broader societal imperative and commitment to equity in healthcare.
abstract.textZh: 在初級保健的背景下，微侵犯需要直接和故意的幹預。未能解決這些經驗會危及公平和勞動力可持續性。領導者必須具備識別、中斷和應對微侵略的能力-不僅要支持個別臨牀醫生，還要加強組織文化和更廣泛的初級保健使命。幹預反映了更廣泛的社會責任和對醫療保健公平的承諾。

articles.titleZh: 偏見對醫學界早期職業女性的影響：「這是小小的日常微侵犯」
